review_scope: All 277 source passages individually reviewed and localized against English, including 10 SEO titles and each FAQ; corrected storage organizer, clothing flat width, quantity by variant, carton dimensions, scale/dimensional and billing weight, refund/credit stages, seller commitments, and all applicable numeric worked examples.

corrections.source: How can I cancel an EastMallBuy order before the agent buys it?
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyが買い付ける前に注文を取り消すには？

corrections.source: Open the order and check whether the purchase has actually been placed with the merchant. Give support the order number and identify the exact line you want cancelled. EastMallBuy's policy treats an unpurchased item separately from one already bought from a seller.
corrections.translation: 注文明細を開き、すでに販売店へ発注したか確認します。サポートには注文番号を伝え、取り消したい明細を特定します。EastMallBuyの規定では、買い付け前の商品と販売店に発注済みの商品で扱いが異なります。

corrections.source: What if the seller has dispatched my order but the warehouse has not received it?
corrections.translation: 販売店が発送済みで、倉庫にまだ届いていない場合は？

corrections.source: Record the domestic tracking number and purchase status, then contact the agent promptly. At this stage the seller's cancellation or return conditions matter. Ask whether the package can be intercepted or whether it must arrive first.
corrections.translation: 中国国内の追跡番号と買い付け状況を控え、早めに代行担当者へ連絡します。この段階では販売店のキャンセル・返品条件が関係します。配送途中で差し止められるか、倉庫到着を待つ必要があるか確認しましょう。

corrections.source: Which costs should I check before agreeing to a return?
corrections.translation: 返品に同意する前に、どの費用を確認しますか？

corrections.source: Ask for an itemized estimate covering the refundable purchase amount, domestic return postage and any relevant deductions. Keep the amounts in the original currency and distinguish an estimate from the final credit.
corrections.translation: 返金対象の商品代、中国国内の返送料、差し引かれる費用を項目別に見積もってもらいます。金額は元の通貨で控え、事前の見積額と実際の入金額を分けて記録します。

corrections.source: How can I show that the seller agreed to an exchange?
corrections.translation: 販売店が交換に同意したことをどう記録しますか？

corrections.source: Save the conversation with the original item, replacement option and seller's reply visible. Confirm whether there is a deadline, who provides the domestic return label and what happens if the replacement goes out of stock.
corrections.translation: 元の商品、交換先の仕様、販売店の回答が分かるやり取りを保存します。期限、国内返送用の送り状を誰が手配するか、交換品が品切れになった場合の対応も確認します。

corrections.source: How do I tell a warehouse deadline from a seller return deadline?
corrections.translation: 倉庫の保管期限と販売店の返品期限はどう区別しますか？

corrections.source: Record the date of warehouse receipt for each item and separately record the seller's deadline for the requested action. A warehouse that still holds an item may be unable to send it back under an expired seller window.
corrections.translation: 各商品の倉庫到着日と、希望する対応について販売店が定める期限を別々に控えます。商品がまだ倉庫にあっても、販売店の受付期限を過ぎると返品できない場合があります。

corrections.source: Why might the balance change before my bank shows a refund?
corrections.translation: 銀行で返金が確認できる前に、アカウント残高が変わるのはなぜですか？

corrections.source: Find the refund destination on the transaction or support decision. An account-balance credit and a reversal to the original payment method create different records. Save the date, currency and payment reference for the route actually used.
corrections.translation: 取引明細またはサポートの回答で返金先を調べます。アカウント残高への入金と元の決済手段への返金では、確認する履歴が違います。実際の返金先に対応する日付、通貨、決済番号を控えます。

corrections.source: Should I discard the shipping carton if the item is damaged?
corrections.translation: 商品が壊れていたら、配送用の段ボール箱は捨ててもよいですか？

corrections.source: Keep the carton, packing and labels while documenting the damage. Take an overall picture followed by closer pictures that show how the damaged area sat against the packaging. Ask what evidence is required before disposal.
corrections.translation: 破損を記録する間は、箱、梱包材、荷札を保管します。まず全体を撮影し、次に破損箇所と梱包材の位置関係が分かるように近くから撮ります。廃棄前に、必要な証拠を担当者に確認します。

corrections.source: What if only one component of a set is defective?
corrections.translation: セットの一部だけに不良があった場合は？

corrections.source: Record the seller option that defines the set and identify the damaged component. Ask whether the resolution applies to the whole set or a single piece before separating the rest or authorizing a partial return.
corrections.translation: セットの内容を示す販売店の選択肢を保存し、どの部品が壊れているか記します。他の部品を分けたり一部返品に同意したりする前に、対応の対象がセット全体か、その一点だけかを確認します。

corrections.source: How do I describe a fit issue accurately?
corrections.translation: 服のサイズが合わないとき、どう説明すればよいですか？

corrections.source: Distinguish the ordered label, the label received, the seller's sizing diagram and your own measurement. A correct label on an uncomfortable garment is a different case from receiving a different ordered size.
corrections.translation: 注文時のサイズ表記、届いた服のタグ、販売店の採寸図、自分の測定結果を分けて示します。注文したサイズでも着心地が合わない場合と、別のサイズが届いた場合とでは、確認してもらう内容が変わります。

corrections.source: What makes a warehouse photograph of a size tag useful?
corrections.translation: 倉庫にサイズタグの写真を頼むときは、何を写してもらいますか？

corrections.source: Request a view that connects the tag to the actual unit. Read the size system, model marking and label text together. A perfectly legible detached tag cannot establish which garment it belonged to.
corrections.translation: タグがどの服に付いているか分かる写真を頼みます。サイズ規格、型番、タグの文字を合わせて読みましょう。取り外したタグだけでは、文字が鮮明でも対象の服を特定できません。

corrections.source: How do I check a marketplace listing before approving a purchase?
corrections.translation: 買い付けを承認する前に、販売ページのどこを確認しますか？

corrections.source: Open the seller's listing, select the actual option and quantity, and read what the price includes. Save the original option wording, listing identifier and subtotal. A title or cover photograph may describe multiple variants.
corrections.translation: 販売店のページで実際に希望の仕様と数量を選び、表示価格に何が含まれるかを読みます。選択肢の原文、商品ページの識別番号、小計を保存します。タイトルや代表写真が複数の仕様に共通することがあります。

corrections.source: How can I compare freight estimates for a mixed parcel?
corrections.translation: 異なる商品を同梱する場合、送料の見積もりはどう比較しますか？

corrections.source: Use the same destination, items and packing assumptions for each comparison. Enter packed dimensions and actual weight with units, then check each available route's restrictions and charging method.
corrections.translation: 配送先、内容品、梱包条件をそろえます。梱包後の外寸と実重量を単位付きで入力し、選べるルートごとに引受制限と料金の計算方法を確認します。

corrections.source: Can a photograph taken before sealing confirm every item in a box?
corrections.translation: 封をする前の写真で、箱の中の商品をすべて確認できますか？

corrections.source: It can document visible contents and packing, but a top view may hide smaller items. Compare an itemized packing record with the picture and ask for clarification about a specific piece while the box is still accessible.
corrections.translation: 見えている内容品と梱包状態は記録できますが、上からの写真では小物が隠れることがあります。梱包明細と写真を照合し、気になる一点は箱を開けられるうちに確認してもらいます。

corrections.source: The seller used two domestic tracking numbers. How do I reconcile the quantities?
corrections.translation: 販売店から国内追跡番号が二つ届きました。数量はどう照合しますか？

corrections.source: Create one row per package with its tracking number, expected units and warehouse receipt. Count units by option. A package marked delivered can contain only the first part of the seller's order.
corrections.translation: 一個口につき一行を使い、追跡番号、入っている予定の数量、倉庫の入荷記録を並べます。数量は注文した仕様別に数えます。配達済みの一個口に、注文の一部しか入っていない場合があります。

corrections.source: How can I report a scratched accessory without confusing a reflection for damage?
corrections.translation: 反射と見間違えずに、付属品の傷を報告するには？

corrections.source: Photograph the same area from two angles with a fixed reference point. Identify whether the mark is on the item, protective film or wrapping. Describe what is visible and what still needs inspection.
corrections.translation: 同じ目印を入れ、同じ部分を二方向から撮影します。跡が商品本体、保護フィルム、外装のどこに見えるか確認し、写真から分かることと追加の検品が必要なことを分けて伝えます。

corrections.source: What should I check before accepting a replacement option?
corrections.translation: 代替品を受け入れる前に、何を確認しますか？

corrections.source: Compare the seller's proposed option with the one ordered, including the model, colour code, size and included accessories. Ask how any price difference will be handled and require confirmation before the substitute is purchased.
corrections.translation: 提示された仕様の型番、色番号、サイズ、付属品を元の注文と比べます。差額の扱いを尋ね、代替品を買い付ける前に確認を取りましょう。

corrections.source: Where are EastMallBuy's current return instructions?
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyの最新の返品手順はどこで確認できますか？

corrections.source: Use the official Refund and Return Policy for the stage of the order and the Help Center for the support path. Recheck the live order before authorizing a return, particularly if a seller has already shipped or a parcel has left the warehouse.
corrections.translation: 公式の「返金・返品ポリシー」で注文段階に応じた規定を、ヘルプセンターで相談窓口を確認します。特に販売店から発送済み、または倉庫から出荷済みの場合は、返品を承認する直前に現状を確認しましょう。

corrections.source: Reporting a damaged accessory to EastMallBuy: photographs that identify the problem
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyに付属品の破損を報告するには：状態が伝わる写真の撮り方

corrections.source: A close-up of a scratch can show a defect but leave support unable to identify the item, the stage at which it appeared or the action you want. Build a short, ordered set of observations before requesting a remedy.
corrections.translation: 傷の接写だけでは、傷は見えても、どの商品でいつ気づいたのか、何を希望しているのかが担当者に伝わりません。対応を求める前に、確認できたことを短く順番に並べます。

corrections.source: EastMallBuy · Refund and Return Policy
corrections.translation: EastMallBuy｜返金・返品ポリシー

corrections.source: EastMallBuy · Help Center
corrections.translation: EastMallBuy｜ヘルプセンター

corrections.source: Start by fixing the time and place
corrections.translation: 最初に気づいた時点と場所を記録する

corrections.source: The first question is where the accessory was when the issue became visible. Was it in a warehouse photograph, inside a parcel being opened at delivery, or already in use? The point is to preserve a timeline, not to guess immediately who caused the damage. EastMallBuy's published return and refund policy distinguishes goods held before international dispatch from cases arising after dispatch. Recording the stage accurately helps an agent find the relevant item or parcel and check which conditions apply.
corrections.translation: 傷に初めて気づいたのは倉庫の写真を見たとき、配達後の開梱時、それとも使用中でしょうか。誰が壊したかを推測する前に、いつどこで見えたかを残します。EastMallBuyが公開している返品・返金ポリシーは、国際発送前に倉庫にある商品と発送後に起きた問題を区別しています。段階が正確なら、担当者も商品や荷物を特定し、適用条件を確認しやすくなります。

corrections.source: Imagine a detachable buckle has arrived with a mark on its polished face. If you first notice it in a warehouse image, save that image with its warehouse entry and order reference. If you first notice it after opening the parcel, record the delivery and unpacking circumstances, including the condition of the outer box and internal protection. If the mark first appears during use, say so. Moving the date back to make a case sound stronger may conflict with earlier photographs and distract from an otherwise legitimate inquiry.
corrections.translation: 例えば、着脱式バックルの磨かれた表面に線が見えたとします。倉庫写真で気づいたら元画像、倉庫の管理番号、注文番号を一緒に保管します。開梱して初めて気づいたなら、配達と開梱の状況、外箱と内部の緩衝材の様子を記録します。使用中に初めて現れたなら、そのとおり伝えます。事実より早い日時を記すと、以前の写真と食い違い、相談の焦点がずれてしまいます。

corrections.source: Show the entire unit before magnifying the mark
corrections.translation: 傷を拡大する前に、付属品全体を写す

corrections.source: Make an overview that includes the accessory and enough of its surroundings to identify it. For the buckle, show its shape, finish, attachment points and position relative to the rest of the set. A second picture can show the disputed area. If the object is tiny, include a recognizably sized reference without covering the mark. A scale is most useful when it lies in roughly the same plane as the feature. A ruler positioned much closer to the camera can distort the apparent size.
corrections.translation: バックルなら全体が見える写真に形状、表面仕上げ、取り付け部、セット内の位置が入るようにし、次の写真で該当箇所を寄って撮ります。小物は大きさの目安となる物を傷に重ならないよう添えます。定規は傷とほぼ同じ平面に置きましょう。カメラの手前に置くと寸法の見え方が変わります。

corrections.source: Keep the original files or warehouse images alongside any annotated copy. An arrow pointing to the scratch can save time, but drawing directly across the defect may obscure its edges. Crop for convenience while retaining an uncropped original. When support asks for another angle, you can show how the close-up relates to the whole object. Keep personal details on shipping labels within the private support channel and avoid sharing an entire address or unrelated order history merely to identify the item.
corrections.translation: 矢印を加えた画像や切り抜きとは別に、撮影した元画像や倉庫写真を保存します。矢印は傷の縁を隠さない位置に置きます。別の角度を求められた際、接写と全体の位置関係を説明できます。荷札の個人情報は非公開のサポート窓口で扱い、特定に不要な住所や他の注文履歴まで共有しないようにします。

corrections.source: Change the lighting to test a plausible alternative
corrections.translation: 照明と角度を変えて反射を見分ける

corrections.source: Metal accessories, polished plastic and glossy packaging reflect their surroundings. A white streak might be a scratch, a fold in protective film or a reflection of a window frame. Place the object on a plain background and change the viewing angle, keeping the marked spot identifiable. A reflection often moves as the object or camera moves; a mark on the surface remains associated with the same physical location. Look for edges of a removable film without peeling it away if doing so could alter the return condition.
corrections.translation: 金属、光沢のある樹脂や包装は周囲を映します。白い線が傷、保護フィルムの折れ、窓枠の反射のどれか、無地の背景で同じ部分を見ながら角度を変えてみます。反射はカメラや物を動かすと移ることが多く、表面の傷は同じ部位に残ります。返品条件に影響しかねない場合は、フィルムの縁を探しても剥がさずに確認します。

corrections.source: Describe the result as an observation. For example, say that a line near the left attachment point remains visible from two angles and that you have not removed the protective film. That is stronger evidence than a claim that the seller shipped a defective buckle when the film still obscures the surface. If the item is in the warehouse, ask for exactly the missing view. An instruction to photograph the same point at an oblique angle is easier to fulfil than a vague request for “better quality control.”
corrections.translation: 「左側の取り付け部近くの線は二方向からも見え、保護フィルムは剥がしていません」と観察結果を具体的に書きます。フィルム越しにしか見えない段階で不良と断定する必要はありません。商品が倉庫にあるなら、「同じ場所を斜めから撮影してください」と頼むと、単に検品の質を上げてほしいと言うより担当者が動きやすくなります。

corrections.source: Document packaging as a separate object
corrections.translation: 商品とは別に梱包状態を撮影する

corrections.source: If damage is noticed after delivery, photograph the outer carton before disposing of it, including dents, crushing or punctures. Then photograph the internal arrangement and the packaging immediately surrounding the accessory. Avoid reconstructing an arrangement you did not observe. If you moved the contents before noticing the damage, explain which part of the arrangement can still be shown and which part is uncertain. Actual packing evidence is more useful than a neat staged picture that gives a false impression of certainty.
corrections.translation: 配達後に気づいた破損は、箱を捨てる前にへこみ、つぶれ、穴を含む外装を撮影します。次に箱の内部と付属品を直接覆う包装を撮ります。気づく前に動かした部分は再現せず、現在も確認できる配置と元の状態が分からない部分を説明します。整えて撮り直した写真より、実際に観察した梱包状態が手掛かりになります。

corrections.source: Look at whether another object could physically contact the damaged area, but do not turn a possibility into a claim about responsibility. A buckle beside a hard case and a dented carton may be relevant observations; neither proves the exact moment of impact. EastMallBuy's policy directs buyers with delivery damage or missing items to preserve packaging evidence and pay attention to its reporting window. Read the current instructions promptly and retain material such as tape when it is required for a claim.
corrections.translation: 他の品物が傷の部分と接触し得たかは確かめても、原因や責任までは断定しません。硬いケースの隣にバックルがあったことや箱のへこみは参考になりますが、衝撃を受けた瞬間の証明にはなりません。EastMallBuyは配達時の破損や不足について、梱包の証拠を保存し申告期限を確認するよう案内しています。最新の手順を早めに読み、申請にテープなどが必要なら保管します。

corrections.source: Match the issue to the exact option and quantity
corrections.translation: 注文した仕様と影響のある数量を特定する

corrections.source: Give the product reference, seller option and number of units involved. If the listing offers silver, black and brushed finishes, make clear which one you purchased. A factory texture shown on the brushed option may look like scratching on the polished version. Compare with the correct reference rather than a different option's promotional picture. For a set of two buckles, state whether one or both show the mark and include an overview showing the whole set.
corrections.translation: 商品番号、販売店で選んだ仕上げ、該当する数量を伝えます。銀色、黒、ヘアライン仕上げがあるなら、購入したものを明記します。ヘアライン仕上げの加工目と鏡面仕上げの傷は、違う仕様の写真で比較すると見誤ります。バックル二個セットなら、一個だけか両方かを記して全体写真も添えます。

corrections.source: Consider the difference between a finish discrepancy and physical damage. A listing that describes a matte finish while the received part is glossy raises an option or description question. A glossy part with a deep gouge raises a condition question. If both apply, separate them into two observations and provide the relevant evidence for each. Doing so helps the merchant respond to the actual complaint without treating a photograph of the wrong finish as proof of an unrelated scratch.
corrections.translation: 仕上げの相違と物理的な破損を分けます。つや消しの説明に対して光沢のある部品が届いたなら、仕様や説明の問題です。光沢部分に深いえぐれがあれば、商品の状態の問題です。両方あれば別々に示し、それぞれに対応する証拠を添えると、販売店も何を確認すべきか判断できます。

corrections.source: Ask for the remedy that fits the evidence
corrections.translation: 確認できた事実に合う対応を依頼する

corrections.source: Explain whether you want an inspection, a replacement component, an exchange of the complete set or information on return eligibility. Start with inspection when the evidence cannot distinguish protective film from surface damage. If a component is clearly unusable, ask whether a replacement component is available and who would cover the relevant postage. Keep the seller's reply and any conditions, especially requirements to return all accessories. The request you make and the outcome eventually offered can differ.
corrections.translation: 追加検品、部品の取り替え、セット全体の交換、返品可否の確認のどれを希望するか書きます。フィルムと本体の傷を見分けられないならまず検品を、部品が明らかに使えないなら交換部品の有無と送料負担を尋ねます。付属品一式の返却など販売店の条件も回答と一緒に保存します。依頼した対応と最終提案が異なる場合があります。

corrections.source: As an example, if the buckle is replaceable but belongs to a bag, an isolated component replacement might avoid shipping the entire bag back. That possibility depends on compatibility and seller approval. Verify the replacement finish, attachment system and dimensions, and ask whether fitting it requires altering the bag. If the seller instead proposes a partial refund, record the amount and whether accepting it closes the case. Only agree after understanding what will happen to both the original component and the financial adjustment.
corrections.translation: バックルを取り替えられるバッグなら、部品だけの交換でバッグ全体を返送せずに済む可能性があります。ただし販売店が応じるか、部品に互換性があるかを確かめます。仕上げ、接続方式、寸法、取り付けにバッグの加工が必要かを確認します。一部返金を提示されたら、金額と受諾すれば案件が終了するかを記録し、元の部品と返金の両方の扱いを理解してから同意します。

corrections.source: Conclude with a short evidence index
corrections.translation: 添付資料を短い一覧で示す

corrections.source: A concise support message can list the item and parcel references, the first point at which the issue was noticed, the visible defect and the requested action. Name the attachments by purpose: full set, affected component, second angle, inner packing and outer carton. Attach only the evidence needed for this case. A file named “buckle-left-edge-second-angle” is easier to refer to than several interchangeable screenshots. Retain the originals in case support needs a full view or a different crop.
corrections.translation: 相談文には商品番号と荷物番号、最初に気づいた段階、見えた不具合、希望対応を簡潔に書きます。添付はセット全体、該当部品、別角度、内装、外箱など目的別に名付けます。「バックル左端・別角度」なら、似た画面画像が何枚もあるより参照しやすくなります。必要なものだけを送り、別の範囲を求められる場合に備えて元画像を保管します。

corrections.source: A complete record does not require certainty about everything. You may know exactly which part is marked and when you first noticed it while remaining unsure whether the surface beneath the film is affected. State that uncertainty plainly. Then ask the most useful next question before the item moves or packaging disappears. The result is a case that another person can inspect and act on, with a clear distinction between what the pictures show, what is still unknown and what resolution you are seeking.
corrections.translation: 証拠がそろっていても、すべてを断定する必要はありません。いつどの部品に跡を見つけたかは明らかでも、フィルムの下まで傷があるか分からないことがあります。不明な部分はそのまま示し、商品が動いたり包装を処分したりする前に必要な確認を依頼します。写真で分かること、未確認事項、求める対応を分けると、次の担当者も判断できます。

corrections.source: A reviewer deciding whether two photographs show the same accessory may look for a fixed feature such as a seam, screw hole or stamped mark. Leave that feature in the frame when moving closer to the damaged point. For a matching pair, place the sound piece alongside the damaged one, facing the same direction. This comparison can reveal a missing cap while still showing which piece came from the affected order.
corrections.translation: 二枚の写真が同じ付属品を写していると分かるよう、縫い目、ねじ穴、刻印など動かない目印を接写にも入れます。一対の部品なら正常な方と傷んだ方を同じ向きに並べます。どの注文の商品かを示しながら、片方にキャップが足りないといった差を確認できます。

corrections.source: EastMallBuy QC and fit: distinguish a wrong item, a measurement issue and a preference
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyの検品とサイズ感：商品違い、採寸のずれ、好みの違いを切り分ける

corrections.source: “My jacket is too small” can mean three different things. Separate what the seller promised, what the warehouse received and how you want the garment to fit before asking for a check or a return.
corrections.translation: 「ジャケットが小さい」という相談には、別サイズの誤納、商品寸法の相違、着心地の好みという三通りがあります。検品や返品を依頼する前に、販売店の表示、倉庫に届いた服、自分の着方を分けて整理します。

corrections.source: Write down what the purchase actually specifies
corrections.translation: 注文時に合意した仕様を書き出す

corrections.source: Begin with the original seller selection and the agent's confirmed order line. Record the model, size, colour and any agreed special measurements. A note you typed but did not see acknowledged is different from an agreed product specification. Keep the original size chart or diagram if one was available at the time of purchase. The live seller listing may now show another version, and a promotional photograph of a model wearing a larger size cannot establish the measurements of the unit you ordered.
corrections.translation: 販売店で選んだ仕様と、代行業者が確定した注文明細から型番、サイズ、色、合意した特注寸法を控えます。自分が書いただけで回答のない備考は、合意済みの仕様とは区別します。購入時のサイズ表や図があれば保存してください。現在のページは別仕様に更新されている場合があり、モデルが大きめのサイズを着た写真からも注文した一点の寸法は特定できません。

corrections.source: Take an illustrative order for a medium overshirt with a listed garment width of 58 centimetres. You plan to wear it over a sweatshirt. There are three separate tests: whether medium was supplied, whether the garment measures as the applicable chart describes, and whether that shape suits the way you plan to wear it. A photograph of a medium tag speaks to the first test. A tape measurement following the diagram speaks to the second. Trying a comparable garment over your sweatshirt helps with the third.
corrections.translation: 例として、身幅58センチと記載されたMサイズのシャツジャケットを、スウェットの上に着るために購入したとします。届いたのがMか、服の実寸が該当するサイズ表と合うか、その形で重ね着できるかは別々の確認です。Mのタグは最初の確認、採寸図どおりに当てたメジャーは二番目、手持ちの似た服をスウェットの上に着ることは三番目に役立ちます。

corrections.source: Identify a selection or fulfilment mismatch
corrections.translation: 注文内容と届いた商品が違う場合

corrections.source: If the confirmed order is for medium and a photograph attached to the correct warehouse item clearly shows a large label, you have a specific discrepancy to investigate. Before concluding that a seller sent the wrong item, confirm the image belongs to your actual unit, particularly if you ordered more than one size. Look for the warehouse entry and an overview connecting the tag with the garment. A detached label photo in a collection of similar shirts can easily be attributed to the wrong purchase.
corrections.translation: Mを注文したのに、該当する倉庫写真のタグにLとあれば、確認すべき具体的な相違があります。複数サイズを頼んだ場合は特に、その写真が実際に対象の服かを先に確かめます。倉庫の明細番号と、タグと服が一緒に見える全体写真を探します。似たシャツが並んでいると、外れたタグだけの写真を別の注文に結び付ける恐れがあります。

corrections.source: Also check whether the labels use different size systems. A number on a regional conversion tag and a letter on the main sewn label can describe the same garment. If the relationship is unclear, present both labels without deciding what they mean. Ask the warehouse or agent to compare them with the exact seller option. State your preference for the next action only after the discrepancy has been confirmed. Requesting a size check is different from authorizing an exchange or accepting a substitute.
corrections.translation: 表記の規格も確認します。地域別換算表の数字と本体に縫い付けたタグのアルファベットが、同じサイズを示す場合があります。対応が不明なら両方の写真を送り、選択した正確な仕様との照合を倉庫や代行担当者に求めます。意図したサイズと違うと分かってから希望する対応を示します。サイズを確認してほしいという依頼だけで、交換や代替品を承認したことにはなりません。

corrections.source: Test a suspected measurement discrepancy
corrections.translation: 採寸に違いがある場合

corrections.source: Find the start and end points in the seller's chart. If chest width is measured across the closed garment from underarm seam to underarm seam, do the same. A tape across the widest visible point at a different height may produce another number. Ask that fabric be laid flat without stretching and that the tape and both endpoints appear together. A close-up of the final marking can be perfectly clear and still fail to answer whether the measurement began at zero.
corrections.translation: 販売店の図で測り始めと終わりを確認します。服の前を閉じ、左右の脇下の縫い目の間を直線で測る身幅なら、同じ方法に合わせます。違う高さで最も広く見える部分を測ると値が変わります。服を伸ばさず平置きにし、両端とメジャーが一枚に入る写真を依頼します。最後の目盛りだけが鮮明でも、ゼロから測ったかは分かりません。

corrections.source: Suppose the warehouse reports 56 centimetres for the overshirt while the chart shows 58. Before interpreting the two-centimetre difference, check that both refer to the same size, style, unit and method. Read any tolerance specified by the seller rather than inventing one. If the endpoints are obscured, seek a clearer view. If the method is correct and the difference persists, present the chart and the measurement side by side. This gives the seller a concrete question to assess under the purchase terms.
corrections.translation: 倉庫の実測が56センチ、サイズ表が58センチだったとします。2センチの差を判断するには、サイズ、型、単位、測り方をそろえます。販売店が示した許容差があればそれを読み、独自の基準を仮定しません。測定位置が隠れていたら撮り直しを依頼し、同じ方法でも差が残ればサイズ表と実測写真を並べて販売店に確認します。

corrections.source: Evaluate personal fit separately from inspection
corrections.translation: 検品と着心地の好みを分ける

corrections.source: Your current favourite overshirt might measure 61 centimetres across the chest. Even a perfectly supplied 58-centimetre garment could feel tight over the sweatshirt you intend to wear. That does not make the warehouse inspection wrong. Record the difference between your reference garment and the seller's stated dimensions, including the conditions of the measurement. A rigid woven fabric and a stretchy knit with the same flat width can also feel different when worn. A width comparison narrows the decision without guaranteeing comfort.
corrections.translation: 手持ちの着やすいシャツジャケットの身幅が61センチなら、正しく届いた身幅58センチの服でも、スウェットの上ではきついかもしれません。それだけで倉庫の検品が誤りとはいえません。手持ちの服と販売店の寸法との差、採寸条件を記録します。平置き寸法が同じでも、伸びない織物と伸縮するニットとでは着心地が変わります。身幅の比較は判断材料の一つです。

corrections.source: Try your reference over the intended base layer and identify the actual limiting point. It might be the upper arm or shoulder rather than the chest. Compare a relevant measurement if one exists. For a drop-shoulder design, the seam position changes the interpretation of a sleeve measured from that seam. A more useful question may concern neck-to-cuff length or bicep width. By identifying what you need to know about fit, you avoid paying for or requesting another measurement that would repeat an already resolved check.
corrections.translation: 実際に合わせるインナーの上に手持ちの服を着て、どこがきついか確かめます。胸でなく上腕や肩かもしれません。ドロップショルダーは縫い目の位置が違うため、そこから測る袖丈だけで比較しにくい場合があります。首元から袖口までの長さや二の腕部分の幅など、必要な寸法を選べば、解決済みの箇所をもう一度測ってもらう手間や費用を避けられます。

corrections.source: Put the facts into the right type of request
corrections.translation: 問題の種類に応じて依頼内容を変える

corrections.source: For a suspected wrong unit, quote the ordered option and the warehouse label or visible variant. For a suspected chart discrepancy, provide the chart, method and unit-specific reading. For a change of preference, say what you received and what alternative you would prefer. EastMallBuy's return policy directs buyers to stage-specific and merchant conditions. Describing the reason accurately helps support determine which conditions and costs apply. A general statement that the quality is bad obscures what remedy you actually need.
corrections.translation: 誤納が疑われる場合は注文仕様と倉庫で確認できたタグや外観、サイズ表との差なら表、採寸方法、その服の実測値を示します。希望変更なら届いた仕様と希望する別の仕様を伝えます。EastMallBuyの返品規定では、注文段階と販売店の条件を確認するよう案内されています。単に品質が悪いと伝えるより、理由が具体的な方が費用や可能な対応を調べやすくなります。

corrections.source: If more than one issue exists, separate them. You might receive the ordered medium but notice a torn seam and also prefer a larger size. Photograph the torn seam and explain your size preference in separate sentences. Then ask whether the seller can replace the damaged piece with the larger option and what price or postage difference would result. This avoids an exchange that resolves the seam while leaving the fit preference unanswered, or a paid size change that silently ignores the documented defect.
corrections.translation: 問題が複数あれば分けます。注文どおりのMでも、縫い目が破れていて、さらにLを希望しているなら、破れの写真とサイズ変更の希望は別々に説明します。その上で、破損品を大きいサイズに交換できるか、価格差や送料が生じるかを尋ねます。破れだけを直してサイズの希望が残ったり、有料のサイズ変更で不良の申し出が見落とされたりするのを防げます。

corrections.source: Compare the available resolutions in practical terms
corrections.translation: 提示された対応を具体的に比べる

corrections.source: Ask what will happen to the item, when it must move and what evidence must accompany it. An additional measurement may settle a doubt without moving anything. An exchange needs a confirmed replacement and a plan for returning the first unit. A return needs the current eligibility, packaging requirements and financial breakdown. A partial credit might leave you with an item that still does not meet your needs. Evaluate the proposed outcome against the original problem rather than accepting the first available button.
corrections.translation: 現品をどうするか、いつまでに動かすか、何の証拠が必要かを尋ねます。採寸の追加だけで解決する場合もあります。交換なら代替品の確定と元商品の返送方法、返品なら適用条件、梱包の条件、精算内訳が必要です。一部返金では着られない服が手元に残ることもあります。画面に出た選択肢が元の問題を解決するか考えて選びます。

corrections.source: For the overshirt scenario, imagine the label and chart both check out but the buyer wants more layering room. A larger size could solve that preference if its shoulder and body dimensions are appropriate. Check the larger size's complete chart before agreeing. Moving from medium to large does not change only chest width. The back length, sleeve and proportions may change too. If the larger version solves one concern and creates another, an exchange can add cost without improving the overall fit.
corrections.translation: シャツジャケットのタグも実寸も正しいものの、購入者がもっと厚着したいとします。上のサイズなら肩や胴に余裕が出る可能性がありますが、交換前にそのサイズの表全体を読みます。MからLにすると身幅だけでなく着丈や袖丈、全体のバランスも変わります。一つの窮屈さが消えて別の箇所が合わなくなるなら、費用をかけても着心地は改善しません。

corrections.source: Keep the final record useful for the next purchase
corrections.translation: 次の購入にも使える形で結果を残す

corrections.source: When the issue is resolved, record the actual received size, measured dimensions, comparison method and outcome. Save any replacement identifier separately from the original item. If you later order another colour from the same seller, recheck the size chart for that version. Do not turn a single observed measurement into a rule that every medium in the shop will fit alike. Different designs use different patterns, materials and intended ease even when they share a familiar label.
corrections.translation: 解決したら、実際の表記サイズ、測定値、比較方法、対応の結果を書きます。交換品の番号は元の商品番号と分けて保存します。後で同じ販売店の別の色を注文するときも、その仕様のサイズ表を再確認します。一着の測定だけで店舗のMがすべて同じとは判断できません。同じ表記でも型紙、素材、想定したゆとりが異なります。

corrections.source: A good final note might say that the ordered medium was supplied, the width matched the seller's method, and the buyer preferred more room over a heavy layer. Another might say that the ordered medium was supplied but the measured garment differed from the chart and the seller accepted an exchange. Those are meaningfully different outcomes. Recording which one occurred gives you a better question for your next purchase and a fairer, more actionable case when something genuinely differs from the order.
corrections.translation: 例えば「注文どおりMが届き、身幅は販売店の測り方と一致したが、厚手の服の上に着るにはもっと余裕が欲しかった」と記録できます。「Mは届いたものの、実寸が表と違い、販売店が交換を受け付けた」とは違う結果です。どちらだったかを記すと、次回の購入時に何を質問するか、実物が注文と違う場合にどの証拠を示すかが明確になります。

corrections.source: Consider how the garment behaves in use as well as its measured size. A correctly measured cuff may feel tight because the fabric has very little stretch. In that case describe the fabric and your fitting experience separately from the measured opening. If the warehouse used a stretched measurement while your reference garment was relaxed, request one comparable reading before deciding which concern to raise with the seller.
corrections.translation: 数字のほかに着用時の素材の動きも考えます。袖口幅は正しくても生地がほとんど伸びず、きつく感じる場合があります。その場合は袖口の実測値、素材、着用感を分けて説明します。倉庫は伸ばして測り、自分は自然な状態で測ったなら、販売店に申し出る前に同じ条件で一度測ってもらいます。

corrections.source: Before EastMallBuy buys from the seller: verify the marketplace offer you selected
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyが買い付ける前に、販売店の商品ページで確認すること

corrections.source: An agent can receive a payment before the seller purchase is placed. Use that distinction to check the item, variant, order quantity and seller conditions while corrections are still relatively straightforward.
corrections.translation: 代行業者への支払いと、代行業者から販売店への発注には時間差がある場合があります。修正しやすいうちに、商品、仕様、個数、販売条件を確かめましょう。

corrections.source: Define the offer independently of its cover image
corrections.translation: 代表画像だけに頼らず購入内容を特定する

corrections.source: Start with the marketplace name, seller and item identifier, then write the exact option you intend to buy. These details identify a narrower offer than the product title. A single listing can group several materials, lengths, sizes or package combinations under one appealing photograph. If the decision depends on a particular feature, such as a removable lining or reinforced base, find the wording or picture attached to the selected option. Save the evidence where you can retrieve it after checkout.
corrections.translation: 販売サイト名、販売店、商品番号と、購入したい選択肢の原文を記録します。一枚の代表写真の下に素材、長さ、サイズ、セット構成の違う商品が並ぶ場合があります。取り外せる裏地や補強された底など、選ぶ決め手があるなら、その仕様を選択したときの説明か画像で確認し、決済後にも見返せる形で保存します。

corrections.source: Imagine a canvas organizer photographed with three removable dividers. One seller option describes an empty organizer, another includes the three dividers and a third sells the dividers alone. A catalogue result may display every version under one name. The question is not simply whether the organizer is the one in the photograph. You need to know which combination your selected unit supplies. Change the option and check the updated price and description before copying the listing into the agent order.
corrections.translation: 取り外せる仕切り三枚と一緒に写った帆布の収納ケースを例にします。選択肢がケース本体のみ、仕切り三枚付き、仕切りのみの三種類でも、商品一覧では同じ名前で表示されるかもしれません。写真のケースと似ているかだけでなく、選んだ販売単位に何が含まれるかを確認します。仕様を切り替えて価格と説明の変化を見てから、代行注文にリンクを貼ります。

corrections.source: Check the seller identity and listing identifier
corrections.translation: 販売店と商品ページの識別番号を照合する

corrections.source: Compare the seller page reached from the catalogue with the seller page associated with the proposed purchase. Similar titles and shared promotional images can point to different shops. The same numeric value on different marketplaces also need not identify the same listing. Keep marketplace and item identifier together. If the original link no longer opens or redirects to another item, record what changed before selecting a similar result. Replacing a missing link is an editorial or purchase decision, not automatic proof of equivalence.
corrections.translation: 商品一覧から開いた店と、買い付け予定の販売店を照合します。似たタイトルや同じ宣材写真を別の店が使うことがあります。別サイトで同じ数字が表示されても同一ページとは限らないため、サイト名と商品番号を組で保存します。元のリンクが切れたり別商品に転送されたりしたら、何が変わったかを記録します。似たページを選び直しても、同等品と確認できたことにはなりません。

corrections.source: Look at the current seller page in addition to any historical QC reference. A previous buyer's picture may show that a particular option existed and looked a certain way at the time. It does not establish current stock or unchanged seller terms. If the original identifier matches but the listing now offers a revised design, document the revised option. A note stating “same seller listing, different model description” is more accurate than treating matching URLs as a guarantee that all product details remained fixed.
corrections.translation: 過去の検品写真とともに、現在の販売ページも見ます。以前の購入者の写真で当時の仕様や外観は確認できても、今の在庫や条件は分かりません。商品番号が同じでも設計が変わったなら、新仕様の選択肢を記録します。「販売ページは同じ、型の説明は変更」と明記する方が、URLの一致だけですべて同じと考えるより正確です。

corrections.source: Read quantity rules before calculating a total
corrections.translation: 合計を計算する前に販売単位を確認する

corrections.source: Identify whether the unit is one piece, a pair, a set or an assortment. Set the requested quantity and inspect any applicable minimum quantity or price tier. A bulk-oriented seller may show a lower per-unit amount for a different order size than the one you want. Check whether assorted sizes or colours count towards the minimum, rather than assuming that distinct options combine automatically. If the selector or checkout does not make this clear, ask before authorizing a larger purchase than intended.
corrections.translation: 一点、一組、セット、詰め合わせのどれが販売単位かを調べます。希望数量に設定し、最低注文数や数量別価格を読みます。卸向け価格は、実際に欲しい数量より多い場合の単価かもしれません。別々のサイズや色を最低数に合算できるかも確認します。選択画面や決済画面で分からなければ、予定より多く注文する前に問い合わせます。

corrections.source: Consider an imaginary offer listing one organizer at 39 yuan and a three-piece set at 105. Buying quantity three of the single organizer yields three units for 117 before other costs. Buying quantity one of the set could yield three pieces for 105, but only if the set actually contains three organizers rather than one organizer and two accessories. Read the contents before comparing the arithmetic. A lower number attached to another unit is not a lower price for the same purchase.
corrections.translation: 架空の例で、収納ケース単品が39元、三点セットが105元とします。単品を数量三で買うとケース三個で諸費用前117元です。セットを数量一で買えば三点105元ですが、ケース三個か、ケース一個と付属品二点かで中身は違います。先に内容を読み、同じ条件で比較します。別の販売単位の数字が小さいだけでは、同じ買い物が安いとはいえません。

corrections.source: Verify size, material and what the photographs can establish
corrections.translation: 寸法、素材、写真で確認できる範囲を見極める

corrections.source: Open the size or dimension chart for the chosen model. Check how length and width were measured, particularly for items that open, fold or taper. For the organizer, a chart might give the exterior width while the useful internal width is narrower because of the dividers. If a specific item must fit inside, the opening dimension and position of the dividers may matter more than the overall size shown in a studio photograph. Note this requirement before deciding which option is acceptable.
corrections.translation: 選んだ型の寸法表を開き、長さや幅の測定位置を確認します。開閉、折り畳み、先細りの形がある商品では特に重要です。収納ケースの表が外幅を示していても、仕切りの分だけ使える内幅は狭くなります。決まった物を入れたいなら、写真から見た全体寸法より開口部や仕切りの位置が重要かもしれません。選択前に必要条件を控えましょう。

corrections.source: Material labels also deserve careful reading. A cover photo can show texture but cannot reliably distinguish two similar fibres, verify a composition claim or tell you how a stiff insert behaves under load. Separate visible features from written seller claims and from facts you have not verified. If material is decisive, ask which specification belongs to the precise selected variant. When the answer is still uncertain, decide whether that uncertainty is acceptable instead of treating a large gallery as a substitute for the missing specification.
corrections.translation: 素材の表示も読みます。写真で質感は見えても、似た繊維を確実に識別したり、混用率や硬い芯材の荷重下での挙動を確かめたりするのは難しいことがあります。目で見える特徴、販売店の記載、未確認事項を区別します。素材が決め手なら希望仕様の情報を尋ね、回答が不明ならその不確かさを受け入れられるか判断します。

corrections.source: Review domestic delivery and seller conditions
corrections.translation: 国内送料と販売店の条件を確認する

corrections.source: Check the destination of any delivery charge shown alongside the merchandise. A seller-to-warehouse fee belongs to the domestic purchase, while international freight is assessed for an outbound parcel. If you are buying from multiple sellers, keep domestic charges attached to the corresponding orders. For a comparison between two listings, use the same quantity and currency and add only the delivery costs actually quoted for that scope. Record whether a total is an observed checkout figure or your own estimate.
corrections.translation: 商品代の横にある送料がどこまでのものかを確認します。販売店から倉庫への国内送料と、倉庫から発送する国際送料は別です。複数店舗から買う場合は各注文に国内送料を対応させます。二つの出品を比べるときは数量と通貨をそろえ、同じ区間で提示された費用だけを加えます。決済画面に表示された金額か、自分で試算した額かも明記します。

corrections.source: Open the relevant seller terms while the offer and selected option are still visible. If you need to exchange a size or return an incomplete set, the merchant's conditions and the stage of the purchase can matter. EastMallBuy's policy explains that stopping a purchase before the agent places it is different from trying to reverse a seller transaction later. Save any important condition, such as the accepted components of a return, with the selection itself rather than relying on a general assumption about all marketplace sellers.
corrections.translation: 選んだ仕様が確認できるうちに該当する販売条件を開きます。サイズ交換や不完全なセットの返品では、購入段階と店舗の条件が関係します。EastMallBuyは、代行発注前に買い付けを止める場合と、後から販売店との取引を取り消す場合を区別しています。返品に必要なセット構成など重要な条件は、全店共通と思い込まず、自分の選択内容と一緒に保存します。

corrections.source: Resolve ambiguity with a bounded instruction
corrections.translation: 不明な場合に買い付けを止める条件を伝える

corrections.source: A useful purchase note has a clear fallback. Identify the exact desired option, the quantity and any condition that should stop the purchase. For example, ask the agent to contact you before buying if the organizer with three dividers is unavailable. This gives the agent an actionable boundary. A direction to find “something close” is less useful when multiple versions differ in size or contents and you have not said which differences are acceptable.
corrections.translation: 購入メモには希望の選択肢、数量、どんな場合に買わずに連絡してほしいかを明記します。「仕切り三枚付きの収納ケースがなければ購入前に連絡してください」なら判断できます。サイズや内容に違いがあるのに、何を妥協できるか言わず「似たものを」と頼むと、意図したものが届きにくくなります。

corrections.source: If the seller proposes a replacement, examine its listing or option as a fresh offer. Compare the feature that drove the original choice, the price, quantity, availability and conditions. Save the reply so that your subsequent warehouse review uses the agreed replacement rather than the first photograph. When a misunderstanding involves multiple lines, explicitly name the order lines that can proceed and the one that needs clarification. One unresolved accessory should not make the rest of the intended purchase ambiguous.
corrections.translation: 代替品の提案は新しい出品として検討します。選ぶ決め手になった特徴、価格、数量、在庫、条件を比較し、回答を保存します。倉庫では最初の写真ではなく、同意した代替品を基準に確認します。複数明細なら、そのまま進めてよい明細と回答待ちの明細を具体的に示し、一点の付属品で注文全体を曖昧にしないようにします。

corrections.source: Retain the confirmation that defines the warehouse check
corrections.translation: 倉庫での確認に使う注文確定記録を保存する

corrections.source: After submitting the order, read the confirmation rather than assuming that the intended selection survived the interface. Reopen the line and compare marketplace, option, quantity and subtotal with the saved notes. If a discrepancy appears, identify whether the agent has already placed the purchase and contact the order channel promptly. Give the exact line number and requested change. Check the response before creating a duplicate purchase intended to correct the first one.
corrections.translation: 注文を送ったら、意図した選択が反映されたか確認画面を読みます。明細を開き直し、販売サイト、仕様、数量、小計を控えと照合します。相違があれば買い付け済みかを確かめてすぐ注文窓口に連絡し、明細番号と希望する変更を伝えます。訂正のつもりで二重注文を作る前に回答を確認しましょう。

corrections.source: Use the confirmed selection to define a short warehouse checklist. For the organizer that might be the specified colour, correct width and three removable dividers visible with the main item. If one detail is hidden in a folded photograph, request the smallest additional observation needed. Your marketplace verification work now serves a second purpose. It lets you tell the difference between an image that merely resembles the intended product and an actual received unit that satisfies the offer you authorized.
corrections.translation: 確定した注文内容から倉庫用の確認項目を絞ります。収納ケースなら色、幅、取り外せる仕切り三枚が本体と一緒に見えるかです。折り畳んだ写真で一箇所だけ隠れていれば、その部分だけ追加確認を頼めます。購入時の裏付けを残すと、写真が似ているだけなのか、受け取った現品が承認した条件を満たすのかを区別できます。

corrections.source: For an order with several variants, keep verification proportional to the possible mistake. A single listing may offer an empty picture frame beside a frame supplied with a print. A screenshot of the displayed artwork cannot resolve which one you selected. Save the option text next to the quantity, then ask the agent to confirm the inclusion if the title is ambiguous. Repeat that check for the second frame size even when the product image stays the same.
corrections.translation: 複数仕様を頼む場合は、取り違えやすい点に絞って確認します。額縁だけと絵入りの額縁を同じページで売っている例では、絵の写真だけで選んだ内容は特定できません。数量の横に選択肢の原文を控え、曖昧なら絵を含むかを担当者に確認します。写真が変わらなくても、別サイズの額について同じ確認を行います。

corrections.source: EastMallBuy shipping estimates for a mixed parcel: when the box changes the bill
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyで複数の商品を同梱するときの送料：箱の大きさと請求重量の関係

corrections.source: Two parcels can weigh the same on a scale and produce different freight estimates. Work through the dimensions of a mixed parcel, test a packing change and identify the number you actually need from the warehouse.
corrections.translation: はかりで同じ重さでも、箱の寸法によって送料が違う場合があります。異なる商品を同梱する例で外寸を計算し、梱包を変えたときの影響と倉庫に確認すべき数字を確かめます。

corrections.source: EastMallBuy · Why shipping charges may differ
corrections.translation: EastMallBuy｜送料に差が出る理由

corrections.source: Start with the packed parcel you intend to send
corrections.translation: 実際に送りたい梱包状態から考える

corrections.source: Imagine that a pair of shoes, a folded jacket and a small metal accessory are waiting in the warehouse. The jacket weighs less than the shoes but occupies more space. The accessory fits inside a gap beside the shoe box. If you estimate freight by adding three item weights, the result ignores both the shipping carton and the shape of this combination. Equally, adding the volumes of three separate retail cartons can exaggerate the size of the final parcel if items will be repacked together.
corrections.translation: 靴一足、折り畳んだジャケット、金属製の小物が倉庫にあるとします。ジャケットは靴より軽くてもかさばり、小物は靴箱の脇に収まります。商品重量を足すだけでは配送箱の重さや組み合わせた形が抜けます。一方、同梱のため詰め直すのに小売箱三つの容積を足すと、最終的な荷物は実物より大きく見積もられます。

corrections.source: Make an inventory in which each row describes an item, the packaging that must stay and the protection the item needs. A shoe box needed for gifting is a requirement. A disposable sleeve around a jacket may be optional. A rigid part that could scrape a shoe needs separation even if it fits neatly in the remaining space. Once these decisions are written down, a quote can correspond to a physically plausible package rather than an optimistic number produced by removing every layer.
corrections.translation: 商品ごとに残す包装と必要な保護材を書きます。贈答用の靴箱は必須でも、ジャケットの外袋は不要かもしれません。靴をこすり得る硬い部品は、隙間に入っても仕切ります。条件を先に決めれば、保護材を全部省いた机上の数字でなく、実際に発送できる荷物に対して見積もりを取れます。

corrections.source: Work an example using actual and dimensional weight
corrections.translation: 実重量と容積重量を計算する

corrections.source: EastMallBuy's Help Center gives an example of a route using parcel dimensions in centimetres and a divisor of 8,000. The following numbers are invented to illustrate that arithmetic. They are neither an actual order nor a promise that a route uses this rule today. Suppose a carton measures 48 by 36 by 30 centimetres and weighs 5.4 kilograms with all contents and packaging. Its external volume is 51,840 cubic centimetres. Dividing by 8,000 produces a dimensional weight of 6.48 kilograms.
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyのヘルプセンターには、外寸をセンチで測り8,000を除数とするルートの例があります。以下は計算を示す架空の数値で、実在する注文や現在の適用ルールを示すものではありません。全内容品と梱包込みで外寸48×36×30センチ、実重量5.4キロの箱なら、外寸から計算した容積は51,840立方センチです。8,000で割ると容積重量は6.48キロになります。

corrections.source: On a route charging the larger of actual and dimensional weight, the starting figure would be 6.48 kilograms before any billing increments or other rules. The parcel has not physically become heavier than 5.4 kilograms. Its box occupies enough space for the route's conversion to produce a larger billing input. Check the current route card to learn how that input is rounded and priced. Knowing the larger weight alone does not tell you the exact cash charge without the tariff and other applicable conditions.
corrections.translation: 実重量と容積重量の大きい方で課金するルートなら、端数処理などをする前の基準は6.48キロです。荷物そのものは5.4キロのままですが、箱が占める空間を換算すると、より大きい値になります。最新のルート条件で刻み幅、丸め方、料金を読みます。どちらの重量が大きいかだけでは、適用料金表や他の条件なしに請求額は計算できません。

corrections.source: Change one dimension and see whether it matters
corrections.translation: 箱の一辺を変えて効果を試す

corrections.source: Consider a revised packing proposal. The shoes retain their retail box and the jacket is folded differently, reducing the carton height from 30 to 25 centimetres while keeping length and width fixed. The new volume is 43,200 cubic centimetres and the example dimensional weight becomes 5.4 kilograms. If the physical weight is unchanged, actual and dimensional weight now coincide. The reduction of five centimetres removed 8,640 cubic centimetres, corresponding to 1.08 kilograms in this example.
corrections.translation: 靴の小売箱は残し、ジャケットの畳み方だけを変えて、縦と横を保ったまま高さを30センチから25センチにするとします。新しい容積は43,200立方センチ、この例での容積重量は5.4キロです。実重量が変わらなければ、二つが一致します。高さ5センチの削減で容積が8,640立方センチ減り、この換算では1.08キロに相当します。

corrections.source: Those results give you a specific question for the warehouse. Can the contents fit within a height of 25 centimetres without crushing the shoes, damaging an insert or leaving a hard object pressing against fabric? Shrinking the carton only on paper does nothing. The calculation identifies an achievable target to investigate. If the smallest suitable carton is actually 28 centimetres tall, recalculate using 28. Keep the revised dimensions beside the estimate and ask whether the figures refer to the sealed exterior or the dimensions of an empty carton.
corrections.translation: 倉庫への質問は「高さ25センチで靴や中敷きをつぶさず、硬い物を生地に押し当てずに収まるか」です。紙の上だけで小さくしても実際の送料は変わりません。適切な箱の最小高が28センチなら28で計算し直します。修正後の寸法を記し、それが封かん後の外寸か空箱の寸法かも尋ねます。

corrections.source: Find the point where reducing volume stops helping
corrections.translation: 箱をさらに小さくしても効果が薄くなる境界を求める

corrections.source: For a fixed actual weight and divisor, there is a boundary volume. In the example, multiply 5.4 kilograms by 8,000 to get 43,200 cubic centimetres. At or below that volume, dimensional weight no longer exceeds actual weight under this assumed rule. With the same 48 by 36 footprint, divide 43,200 by 1,728 to find the 25-centimetre boundary height. This explains why a reduction from 30 to 25 centimetres can matter while further compression may offer diminishing freight benefit.
corrections.translation: 実重量と除数が固定なら、境界の容積を計算できます。5.4キロに8,000を掛けると43,200立方センチです。この例のルールなら、それ以下の容積では容積重量が実重量を超えません。底面48×36センチの面積1,728平方センチで43,200を割ると、境界の高さは25センチです。30から25センチへの削減には意味があっても、その先は送料への効果が小さくなり得ます。

corrections.source: Suppose you could force the carton down to 22 centimetres. The dimensional calculation would give 4.752 kilograms, but a parcel still weighing 5.4 kilograms continues to be rated from at least its physical weight on this illustrative route. Compare that result with the cost and risk of more aggressive packing. If reducing height beyond the boundary compromises protection, the supposed saving may disappear before you even consider the possibility of damage. Check whether a separate size band or route limit changes the outcome before finalizing the choice.
corrections.translation: 無理に高さを22センチまで詰めると、容積重量は4.752キロになります。ただし実重量5.4キロなら、この例のルートでは少なくとも5.4キロを基に課金されます。強い圧縮の追加費用や破損リスクと比較します。境界以下で保護を犠牲にしても、送料は下がらないかもしれません。別の寸法区分やルートの上限が影響するかを確認してから決めましょう。

corrections.source: Compare two routes without mixing their inputs
corrections.translation: 同じ入力条件で二つのルートを比べる

corrections.source: Take the same measured parcel to both route estimates. Record destination, contents, dimensions, weight, route name and quote time. Only change the route in this first comparison. A quote based on an unboxed pair of shoes and a second quote based on a boxed pair answer different questions. Make a second pair of estimates if you want to investigate the packaging decision too. This produces four intelligible comparisons rather than two attractive totals whose assumptions cannot be recovered.
corrections.translation: 一つの実測済み荷物を両方の見積もりに使います。配送先、内容、寸法、重量、ルート名、見積時刻を記し、最初はルートだけを変えます。靴箱なしの荷物と靴箱付きの荷物は別条件です。梱包の選択も比べるなら、別の梱包案について両ルートの見積もりを取ります。こうすれば前提の不明な総額二つでなく、何が違うか分かる四つの金額が得られます。

corrections.source: Read the route terms for the parcel you actually intend to send. A route that cannot accept one component, exceeds a side-length limit or requires different packing is a conditional option. Keep the condition beside the price. If you would have to split the metal accessory into a separate parcel, include the second parcel's full quote before deciding which option is cheaper. The lowest headline price can be accurate for the route and still be irrelevant to your particular combination of items.
corrections.translation: 送りたい荷物に適用される条件を読みます。一点が取扱対象外、辺の長さが上限超過、指定の梱包が必要などの条件を、価格の横に書きます。金属小物を別送する必要があれば、別の荷物の見積総額も加えてから安い方を判断します。最安の表示額そのものは正しくても、自分の商品の組み合わせには適用されない場合があります。

corrections.source: Keep service charges and freight in separate columns
corrections.translation: 梱包サービス料と運賃は別の欄に記録する

corrections.source: Record any selected packing service separately from the freight calculation. The service might change dimensions, weight or both, but its price is an additional part of the total. Compare the combined amount for each proposal. If option A quotes 100 units of currency for transport and option B quotes 93 plus a nine-unit service, option B totals 102. These imaginary round numbers illustrate why the smaller transport charge need not produce a smaller final payment. Use the original quote currency throughout.
corrections.translation: 梱包サービスで寸法や重量が変わっても、サービス料金自体は運賃に加える別費用です。案ごとに両方を合計します。架空の例で同一通貨の案Aの運賃が100、案Bが運賃93とサービス料9なら、Bの総額は102です。運賃が小さくても支払総額は高くなります。一貫して見積もりの元の通貨を使います。

corrections.source: Apply the same care to reductions and coupons. Enter a discount only if it applies to the specific route and parcel you will submit. Note whether the discount reduces freight only or another part of the payment. Do not count a displayed promotion a second time if the route estimate already includes it. Leaving an unverified discount out of the working total produces a conservative budget and makes it easier to reconcile the eventual payment than guessing which of several displayed amounts is final.
corrections.translation: 割引やクーポンは実際に出す荷物とルートが対象の場合だけ計上します。運賃だけの値引きか、別費用にも及ぶかを記します。ルートの見積もりに反映済みなら二重に引きません。未確認の値引きを仮の予算に入れなければ、どの数字が最終額か推測するより後で実際の支払いと照合しやすくなります。

corrections.source: Compare the estimate with the final packed measurements
corrections.translation: 最終梱包の測定値と見積もりを照合する

corrections.source: When the warehouse provides the final record, compare the dimensions in the same orientation and units, then compare actual weight and route. A change from a 48-centimetre length to a 50-centimetre length may matter even if the scale reading is almost unchanged. Ask whether protecting a protruding part, keeping a retail box or switching outer cartons explains the difference. Send the original estimate and current packed figures together, identifying the one change you are trying to understand.
corrections.translation: 倉庫の最終記録が出たら、向きと単位をそろえて寸法を比べ、続いて実重量とルートを確認します。重さがほぼ同じでも長辺48センチが50センチになれば影響が出ることがあります。突出部の保護、小売箱の維持、配送箱の変更が理由かを尋ねます。元の見積もりと梱包後の値を添え、どの違いを確認したいか示します。

corrections.source: Your final note should let someone reproduce the decision without seeing your shopping cart. List what was packed, what protection stayed, the measured exterior, actual weight, route and total quote. Mark any unknowns, such as the final billing increment, as questions for the live route information. For the example parcel, the important finding was that carton height controlled the larger billing weight above 25 centimetres. For another parcel, scale weight or a route eligibility limit may control the entire choice. The method stays useful because the answer comes from the measured package.
corrections.translation: 最終記録には内容品、残した保護材、測定した外寸、実重量、ルート、見積総額を書き、買い物かごを見なくても判断を再現できるようにします。請求重量の刻み幅など未確認事項は最新ルート情報で確かめます。この例では高さが25センチを超える間、箱の高さが課金重量を左右しました。別の荷物では実重量や引受寸法が決め手になります。実際の荷物から判断する手順は共通です。

corrections.source: When comparing two packing plans, write the contents beside each quote. A cheaper figure for a parcel without the display box answers a different question from a quote that preserves the box. Keeping those descriptions visible also gives the recipient a reliable expectation of what should arrive.
corrections.translation: 梱包案を二つ比べるなら、各見積額の横に内容物を記します。化粧箱なしの安い見積もりと、化粧箱を残す見積もりでは内容が違います。説明を添えておけば、受取人も何が届く予定か確認できます。

corrections.source: EastMallBuy warehouse QC: how to read a size label in context
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyの倉庫検品：サイズ表記を商品と照らし合わせて読む方法

corrections.source: A sharp photograph of a tag may confirm a printed size while leaving the unit, size system or fit unresolved. Learn which details belong together before accepting a label as evidence for a shipping decision.
corrections.translation: タグが鮮明でも、分かるのは印刷されたサイズだけかもしれません。どの商品か、どの規格か、着心地はどうかを切り分け、発送判断に使える証拠をそろえます。

corrections.source: Identify the garment the label belongs to
corrections.translation: タグがどの服に付いているか確認する

corrections.source: Open the warehouse entry for the item you want to check. Find an overview that shows the garment, then find the picture of its attached label. Check that both images belong to the same warehouse entry and order. This matters when two similar shirts arrive in adjacent order lines. An image downloaded into a general photo folder can lose the record that connected it to one shirt rather than the other. Keep the reference in the filename or case note.
corrections.translation: 確認したい倉庫明細を開き、服の全体写真と付いたままのタグの写真を探します。両方が同じ注文・同じ倉庫明細か確認してください。似たシャツが隣り合う明細にあるときは特に重要です。写真だけをまとめて保存すると対応関係を失うので、ファイル名か記録に管理番号を書きます。

corrections.source: Imagine you bought identical blue shirts in medium and large for different people. Both front views show the same colour and design. A close-up marked medium does not tell you which unit it describes unless the record retains that connection. Start with separate notes for the two units, even if the seller packed them together. If only one label has been photographed, record which size is confirmed and request a check on the other. Do not fill the second record by elimination when both units could conceivably be the same size.
corrections.translation: 同じ青いシャツのMとLを別々の人に買った場合、正面からの色やデザインは同じです。Mのタグの接写だけでは、どの一着かは元の記録なしに分かりません。同梱で届いても二着を別々に控えます。一方だけ撮影されたならそのサイズを確認済みとし、他方は改めて確認を依頼します。二着とも同じサイズの可能性があるので、消去法で残りを埋めません。

corrections.source: Read all markings before choosing the relevant one
corrections.translation: タグ全体を読み、必要な表記を選ぶ

corrections.source: Labels can contain model codes, sizes for several markets, fabric composition, washing instructions and manufacturing numbers. Locate the marking that the seller uses for the selected option. A number beside a region abbreviation may belong to a conversion table, while a larger number elsewhere on the tag may identify the model. Read the surrounding text and orientation rather than extracting the most prominent digits. If the photo cuts off the headings above several values, ask for the complete label.
corrections.translation: タグには型番、複数地域のサイズ、素材、洗濯表示、製造番号などがあります。注文した選択肢に対応する表記を探します。地域略号の横の数字は換算サイズ、別の大きい数字は型番かもしれません。目立つ数字だけを抜き出さず、見出しや周囲の文字、並びを読みます。上部が切れていたらタグ全体の写真を頼みます。

corrections.source: Consider a shoe label that lists several regional systems. A marking of 8 next to one system and 41 next to another may be part of one conversion printed by the manufacturer. Comparing an order for an unspecified “8” with the visible 41 establishes little until the ordered system is identified. Go back to the original option wording and seller chart. If the original selection did not name a system, explain this uncertainty instead of treating a plausible conversion found elsewhere as the seller's own chart.
corrections.translation: 靴のタグで一方の規格に8、別の規格に41とあれば、メーカーが同じ靴のサイズ換算を記した可能性があります。単に「8」と注文した記録と41の数字だけでは誤納といえません。元の選択肢と販売店の表で、どの規格を選んだか確認します。元の表示に規格がなければそう伝え、他所の換算表を販売店のものと決めつけません。

corrections.source: Check whether a removable label and a sewn label agree
corrections.translation: 下げ札と縫い付けタグの表記を比べる

corrections.source: A retail hangtag can be attached to the wrong garment, and an outer bag can be marked differently from the item inside. If a discrepancy appears, determine which label each photograph shows. A picture of a size sticker on a plastic sleeve identifies the sleeve's marking. A picture of a sewn label attached to the garment gives different evidence. A wide view that includes both can make the distinction clearer without requiring multiple unexplained close-ups.
corrections.translation: 小売用の下げ札を別の服に付けたり、外袋と中身の表記が違ったりすることがあります。相違があれば、写真がどのラベルを写したか確かめます。袋のサイズシールで確認できるのは袋の表示です。服に縫い付けたタグの写真は別の証拠になります。両方を含む引きの写真が一枚あれば、説明のない接写が何枚もあるより区別しやすくなります。

corrections.source: Suppose the outer sleeve reads large while the sewn label reads medium and the order specifies medium. Record all three facts. The unit may be the intended size packed in a different sleeve, or there may be another issue requiring a physical measurement. Do not tell support that a large garment was received solely because of the sleeve sticker. Ask for verification of the item, using the actual garment label and an appropriate measurement where useful. Also decide whether the incorrect packaging matters for gifting or a potential return.
corrections.translation: 外袋はL、縫い付けタグはM、注文はMなら、三つの事実をすべて記録します。正しい服を別サイズの袋に入れただけかもしれず、実測が必要な別の問題かもしれません。袋の表示だけでLが届いたとは申告せず、服のタグと必要な採寸で現物照合を頼みます。贈答や返品を考えているなら、袋の誤表示自体が支障になるかも確認します。

corrections.source: Decide whether the label answers your real question
corrections.translation: 本当に知りたいことをタグで確認できるか考える

corrections.source: Sometimes the only question is fulfilment: did the seller send the option you ordered? In that case a clear, connected label may settle the matter. If your concern is comfort or dimensions, the tag answers less. Two medium jackets can be cut differently, and even a correctly labelled piece can fit differently from a garment you already own. State whether you need identification, measurement or a view of a particular construction feature before requesting further photographs.
corrections.translation: 注文仕様が届いたかだけなら、どの服か特定できる鮮明なタグで解決する場合があります。寸法や着心地はタグだけでは判断できません。同じMのジャケットでも型が違い、正しいサイズが届いても手持ちの服とは着用感が違うことがあります。追加写真を頼む前に、識別、採寸、縫製の特定部分のどれを見たいか伝えます。

corrections.source: For a sweatshirt, identify the dimension that would determine your decision. If chest room matters, ask for a flat measurement under the arms following the seller's method. If the concern is sleeve length on a dropped shoulder, name the endpoints carefully. Do not ask for “a photo of size” when what you need is the closed garment laid flat with a visible tape. The request for the label and the request for a measurement can both be valid, but they are not substitutes for each other.
corrections.translation: スウェットなら判断に必要な寸法を決めます。胸まわりのゆとりなら販売店の方法で脇下間の平置き身幅を、ドロップショルダーの袖丈なら測り始めと終わりを明示して頼みます。前を閉じて平置きした服とメジャーの写真が必要なら、そのとおり依頼します。タグと採寸の写真はどちらも役立ちますが、答える質問が異なります。

corrections.source: Test a size mismatch without exaggerating the evidence
corrections.translation: サイズ違いを疑うときは証拠の範囲を確かめる

corrections.source: Compare four items in order: the seller option selected, the agent purchase confirmation, the marking attached to the unit and any physical measurement. Identify the first pair that disagrees. If the seller selection says medium but the agent confirmation says large, the problem appears before warehouse inspection. If the order is medium, the attached label is large and the photographs clearly belong to the correct item, the warehouse evidence supports a direct query about a wrong size.
corrections.translation: 販売店で選んだ仕様、代行業者の購入確認、現品に付いた表記、実測の順に並べ、どこで初めて違ったかを探します。選択はMで購入確認がLなら、すでに倉庫検品より前に食い違いがあります。注文はM、現物のタグはLで写真も対象商品と一致するなら、誤納の有無を具体的に問い合わせられます。

corrections.source: If selection and label match but the measurement appears off, compare units, endpoints and the seller's stated tolerance. A measurement taken from the back collar edge may differ from one taken from the shoulder. A garment measured while unfastened may not be comparable with one measured closed. Give support the precise conflict rather than a conclusion unsupported by the method. “Medium label; flat width appears different from the medium chart; tape start not visible” identifies both the concern and the missing evidence.
corrections.translation: 注文とタグが一致しても寸法が違うように見えたら、単位、両端の位置、販売店の許容差を確認します。後ろ襟からと肩からでは長さが変わり、前を開けた服と閉じた服も比較できない場合があります。「タグはM。平置き身幅がMの表と違うように見えるが、メジャーの起点が見えない」と書けば、相違と追加確認が必要な点の両方が伝わります。

corrections.source: Prepare a short request the warehouse can fulfil
corrections.translation: 倉庫が対応できる具体的な撮影依頼にする

corrections.source: A useful request names the warehouse reference, the unit and the desired view. For example, ask for one photograph showing the blue shirt and attached size label together, followed by a closer view where the printed letter is readable. If two units are involved, request separate identification for each. Alter the example to match the service actually available in your order. Avoid requesting a whole new gallery when one missing label heading or a single overview would settle the matter.
corrections.translation: 倉庫番号、対象の服、希望する構図を書きます。例えば青いシャツと付いたままのサイズタグを一枚に収め、次に文字が読める接写を頼みます。二着ならどちらか分かるよう個別に依頼します。実際の注文で利用できるサービスに合わせ、タグの見出し一箇所や全体写真一枚で足りるときは、写真一式を頼み直さなくても十分です。

corrections.source: When a photo is supplied, check what it resolves before sending a second request. A clearer label may establish that the ordered size arrived but leave an external sleeve mismatch unanswered. Conversely, a full garment shot may confirm the style while the size remains unreadable. Keep the unresolved question narrow. If the warehouse cannot provide the requested view, decide whether the available evidence is sufficient for you or whether the order needs further discussion before it moves into an international parcel.
corrections.translation: 写真が来たら、再依頼の前にどこまで解決したかを見ます。タグの文字が読めて注文サイズの到着は分かっても、外袋の不一致は残る場合があります。逆に全体写真で型は確認できてもサイズは読めないかもしれません。未解決の点を絞り、撮影できない場合は、今の証拠で発送するか、国際配送に回す前にさらに相談するかを判断します。

corrections.source: Preserve the interpretation alongside the image
corrections.translation: 写真と一緒に読み取れた内容を保存する

corrections.source: Save the selected option, relevant order line, overview and readable label together. Add one sentence explaining what the evidence establishes. For instance: “The sewn label on the unit in warehouse entry A matches the medium option; the outer sleeve is marked large; physical fit has not been tested.” This record is considerably more useful than a thumbnail named “QC good” because it preserves both the conclusion and its scope.
corrections.translation: 注文仕様、該当明細、全体写真、読めるタグをまとめ、一文で結論を記します。例えば「倉庫明細Aの縫い付けタグは注文したMと一致。外袋はL。着心地は未確認」です。「検品OK」だけの画像より、確認した範囲も分かり、後で見返しやすくなります。

corrections.source: If the evidence supports a return or exchange discussion, check EastMallBuy's current policy for the stage of the item and the seller's terms. If it supports shipping, retain the distinction between confirming the label and guaranteeing fit. At delivery you can compare the actual unit with the record and refine your personal sizing notes. A size-label photo is most valuable when you know which item it depicts, which marking matters and exactly which decision that marking helps you make.
corrections.translation: 返品や交換の相談に進むなら、EastMallBuyの現在の規定を商品の段階と販売店の条件に合わせて確認します。発送を選ぶ場合も、タグ確認と着心地の保証は区別します。受取後は現物と記録を比べ、自分用のサイズ情報を更新できます。対象商品、関連する表記、その表記で判断できることが明確なとき、タグの写真が役立ちます。

corrections.source: An embroidered neck label and a removable cardboard hangtag can disagree. Photograph both in relation to the garment, then ask the warehouse to check the sewn label and any seller code against your order. A loose tag may have moved between items. If the garment itself has no permanent size marking, record that limitation and request a measurement that distinguishes the two possible sizes. Preserve the original tag and packaging while the seller reviews the discrepancy.
corrections.translation: 刺しゅうした襟タグと取り外せる紙の下げ札で表示が違う場合があります。服との位置関係が分かるよう両方を撮影し、縫い付けタグと販売店の型番を注文と照合してもらいます。外れた下げ札は別の服から移った可能性があります。恒久的な表記がなければ、その限界を記録し、二つの候補サイズを区別できる実寸を頼みます。販売店の確認中は元のタグと包装を残します。

corrections.source: How to reconcile a split EastMallBuy order by item and size
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyの注文が分割で届いたら：商品とサイズを照合する方法

corrections.source: Match seller parcels, warehouse records and purchased quantities when tracking shows several deliveries for one EastMallBuy order.
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyの一件の注文に複数の配達履歴がある場合、販売店の各荷物、倉庫の受領記録、注文した仕様別数量を照合します。

corrections.source: Count the things you bought
corrections.translation: まず注文した商品の数量を数える

corrections.source: One order can produce several tracking numbers. A parcel can contain several pieces. A warehouse photograph can show several angles of the same piece. All three counts might differ even when the seller has supplied everything correctly. Start with the accepted purchase details. Write one row for each exact combination of product, size, colour and quantity. Include any seller code visible at the time of purchase. This gives you a fixed point of comparison while other records continue to arrive.
corrections.translation: 一つの注文に複数の追跡番号が付き、一個口に複数の商品が入り、一点の写真が複数枚あることがあります。正しく納品されても、この三つの数は一致しません。確定した注文を基に、商品、サイズ、色の組み合わせごとに一行を使って数量と販売店の商品コードを控えます。後から記録が増えても、これを基準に照合できます。

corrections.source: Imagine a group ordering six shirts from one listing. They buy two blue XS shirts, three blue M shirts and one green L shirt. Record those as three rows. Adding them up to six is a useful arithmetic check, yet receiving six shirts in total does not settle whether the order is complete. If the warehouse holds two blue XS and four blue M shirts, a green L is still missing and a blue M needs an explanation. Recording only the total would conceal both issues.
corrections.translation: 同じ出品からシャツ六枚を共同購入する例なら、青XS二枚、青M三枚、緑L一枚を三行に分けます。合計が六枚かは計算の確認にはなりますが、六枚届いただけでは完了ではありません。青XS二枚と青M四枚なら、緑Lが一枚足りず、青Mが一枚多い理由も確認が必要です。総数しか書かないと両方が見えなくなります。

corrections.source: Follow the numbers across the domestic journey
corrections.translation: 中国国内の配送を追跡番号でたどる

corrections.source: Find the tracking numbers associated with the purchase in the order record or a seller message. Keep the spelling, carrier name and last update for each one. Ask the agent to identify the order line associated with a number if its origin is unclear. Two identical carrier numbers shown on two product rows generally refer to one package. Count distinct numbers separately from the number of order rows to which they refer.
corrections.translation: 注文履歴や販売店のメッセージから、購入に付いた各追跡番号を探します。表記、配送会社、最終更新を保存し、どの注文番号に付くか不明なら担当者に尋ねます。同一会社の同じ追跡番号が商品二行に載っていれば、通常は一個口です。明細の行数とは別に、異なる追跡番号の数を数えます。

corrections.source: Give the example shipments labels A, B and C on your private working sheet. Package A has a delivery scan and two warehouse photographs of individual blue XS shirts. Package B has a delivery scan and a warehouse record describing two blue M shirts. Package C is in transit and the contents have yet to be checked. The buyer can account for four pieces from the first two packages. One blue M and one green L remain open. The tracking history alone cannot tell the buyer what those last two pieces will be.
corrections.translation: 作業表で仮の荷物をA、B、Cとします。Aは配達済みで青XS二枚をそれぞれ写した倉庫写真があります。Bも配達済みで青M二枚との入荷記録があります。Cは輸送中で中身は未確認です。AとBで四枚が確認でき、青M一枚と緑L一枚が未確認です。追跡履歴だけでは、残り二枚が実際にCに入っているかは分かりません。

corrections.source: Identify what the warehouse actually counted
corrections.translation: 倉庫が現物の何を数えたか確認する

corrections.source: Look for warehouse evidence that distinguishes individual physical pieces. A flat lay of a blue shirt beside a close-up of its label can establish the appearance and size of one shirt. Those two pictures cannot establish a quantity of two. Ask for a single overview with the pieces separated or for a staff count linked to the appropriate warehouse record. Identical folded items stacked inside one wrapper can be difficult to distinguish even in a clear image.
corrections.translation: 別々の現物を区別できる証拠を探します。青シャツの全体写真とそのタグの接写では、一枚の外観とサイズは確認できますが、二枚の到着は証明できません。複数の服を離して一枚に収めた写真か、倉庫明細を指定してスタッフによる数量確認を頼みます。同じ折り畳み方で一袋に重なっていると、鮮明な画像でも見分けにくいことがあります。

corrections.source: Record counts at the most precise level the evidence supports. If staff confirm two shirts but show only one size label, mark two received and one size verified. Keep the outstanding size check visible. If a sealed multipack must stay closed for a possible return, ask what the external packaging identifies before requesting that anyone opens it. Preserve any uncertainty in writing. An incomplete count provides a better basis for a follow-up question than a confident figure inferred from the folds in a bag.
corrections.translation: 証拠に合わせて細かく記録します。スタッフは二枚と確認したもののタグの写真が一枚なら「二枚受領、サイズ確認一枚」としておきます。返品に備え密封セットを開けられないなら、開封を頼む前に外装で識別できることを尋ねます。袋の折り目から数量を推測して確定するより、未確認の部分を明記する方が次の質問につながります。

corrections.source: Keep an open quantity apart from a shortage
corrections.translation: 未確認分と確定した不足を分ける

corrections.source: Suppose C now arrives with one green L. The group has five shirts, one blue M remains outstanding and the final known package has been received. Ask whether the seller assigned another tracking number or whether staff still have a package awaiting intake. Include the current count by option and the three known tracking numbers. With that information the agent can look for an unlinked shipment, check an intake record or approach the seller with a precise shortage.
corrections.translation: Cに緑Lが一枚入っていたとします。これで五枚となり、判明している全荷物を受け取ったのに青Mが一枚未確認です。別の追跡番号があるか、倉庫で入荷処理待ちがないかを尋ねます。現在の仕様別数量と既知の追跡番号三つを示すと、担当者は未紐付けの荷物、入荷履歴、販売店への不足照会を調べやすくなります。

corrections.source: There is a meaningful difference between an open quantity and a confirmed shortage. A delivery scan for C alongside a warehouse entry still awaiting inspection leaves its contents uncertain. A completed count from C, confirmation that all listed packages have been checked and no further dispatch reported gives the buyer a clearer case to take up. Record the time of each observation. Staff reading the conversation later then know which facts were available when you raised the question and which changed afterward.
corrections.translation: Cが配達済みでも倉庫検品待ちなら、中身はまだ不明です。Cを数え終わり、記載されたすべての荷物を点検し、追加発送も報告されていなければ、不足を具体的に申し出られます。観察した日時を記録すると、後から読む担当者も、質問時点で分かっていたことと、その後判明したことを区別できます。

corrections.source: Resolve duplicate or contradictory entries
corrections.translation: 重複や矛盾する明細を解く

corrections.source: A seller might supply a replacement tracking number after a label change. Preserve the old record, mark the relationship as unconfirmed and ask whether both numbers moved physical packages. If tracking histories share the same events, treat that as a reason to investigate. Similar dates and locations alone do not establish a relabel. A warehouse record attached twice to a shopping order creates a comparable ambiguity. Confirm how many packages staff physically received before using either entry twice.
corrections.translation: 荷札の変更で販売店が別の追跡番号を出す場合があります。古い番号を残し、新旧の関係は未確認と記して、それぞれ実際に別の荷物が動いたか尋ねます。履歴が同じなら調べる手掛かりにはなりますが、日時と場所が似ただけで貼り替えを断定できません。同じ倉庫記録が注文に二重登録された場合も、二回数える前に現物を何個受け取ったか確かめます。

corrections.source: Apply the same care to seller messages. An early message announcing three shirts in parcel B is evidence of the intended packing. A later warehouse count showing two is evidence of observed contents. Keep both entries and ask staff to check the packing slip, wrapper and order linkage. Spelling out that difference gives the agent room to locate a separated item without forcing an immediate conclusion about responsibility. Save the seller's answer beside the relevant package, including which colour or size it addresses.
corrections.translation: 販売店が「Bには三枚」と事前に書いた記録は予定した中身を示し、後日の倉庫検品で二枚という記録は実際に確認した中身を示します。両方を保存し、納品書、外袋、注文との紐付けを調べてもらいます。何が違うかを示せば、責任を即断せず別の場所に分かれた一枚を探せます。販売店の回答には該当荷物と色・サイズを対応させます。

corrections.source: Decide whether the partial order can move
corrections.translation: 届いた分だけを先に発送できるか判断する

corrections.source: If the confirmed pieces are due to travel internationally, decide whether sending them separately would hinder a warehouse check, exchange or other requested resolution. Ask for current eligibility and costs through the agent before releasing the affected items. EastMallBuy publishes return information and provides a help centre. The answer for a particular order can depend on its stage, the seller and the condition of the goods. Keep the purchase and package identifiers available when seeking that answer.
corrections.translation: 確認済みの服を先に国際発送すると、残った商品の照合や交換などに支障がないかを確認します。出庫を許可する前に、担当者を通じて現在の条件と費用を尋ねます。EastMallBuyは返品案内とヘルプセンターを公開していますが、個別の回答は注文段階、販売店、商品の状態で変わります。購入番号と荷物番号を用意して問い合わせます。

corrections.source: A buyer who urgently needs the XS shirts may ask about dispatching just those two. Another buyer who needs the full matching group may prefer to keep everything together while the M quantity is investigated. Both can use the same reconciliation sheet. For the first buyer it identifies exactly which pieces may be released. For the second it identifies the unresolved quantity and helps prevent a partial parcel being mistaken for the entire group order.
corrections.translation: XSを急いで使う人は確認できた二枚だけの発送を相談できます。全員分をそろえたい人はMの確認中もまとめて置く方がよいかもしれません。同じ照合表で、前者は発送してよい服を指定でき、後者は未解決の数量を示して一部だけの荷物を全部と取り違えずに済みます。

corrections.source: Close the record when the figures agree
corrections.translation: 数量と対応が一致してから記録を閉じる

corrections.source: Suppose the seller confirms that a fourth parcel contains the remaining M shirt. Add parcel D, keep the shortage inquiry open and wait for the warehouse to identify both the colour and the label. Once verified, your final rows read two of two blue XS, three of three blue M and one of one green L. If the seller instead offers a refund for the unavailable M, record two received and one refunded once the transaction is confirmed. These outcomes settle the same purchased quantity in different ways.
corrections.translation: 販売店が四個目に残りのMを入れたと回答したなら、荷物Dを追加し、倉庫で色とタグを確認するまで問い合わせを開いたままにします。確認後は青XS二枚中二枚、青M三枚中三枚、緑L一枚中一枚です。在庫切れのMを一枚返金する提案なら、実際の入金確認後に「青M二枚受領、一枚返金」と記します。同じ購入数量でも解決のしかたは異なります。

corrections.source: For a group order, share a short final statement with each participant showing the item assigned to them and any unresolved remedy. Keep the settlement records apart from the later international tracking number. A six-piece domestic order might travel internationally in two boxes or five physical pieces might travel after one refund. When those boxes arrive, the recipient can compare each one with its actual dispatch list. That final list also explains why the parcel in hand contains a different number of shirts from the original purchase.
corrections.translation: 共同購入では各人に割り当てる服と未解決の対応を短く共有し、精算と後の国際追跡番号を分けます。国内で六点買っても国際配送で二箱に分かれたり、一点返金後に五点を発送したりします。受取人は実際の発送一覧と各箱を照合できます。元の注文と受取数量が違う理由も一覧に残ります。

corrections.source: If two people share the same size, assign individual pieces only after the common size row balances. Marking one blue M shirt for each person too early can create the impression that everyone has received a shirt even when only two exist. Keep the physical count beside the assignment list and name the person who checked it. That small distinction matters when a fourth package arrives after the initial allocation.
corrections.translation: 同じサイズの希望者が二人以上いる場合は、そのサイズの実数を照合してから個々の服を割り当てます。青Mを先に一人一枚ずつ記入すると、現物が二枚しかないのに全員分あるように見える場合があります。割当表の隣に実数と確認者を記します。初回の割り当て後に四個目の荷物が届いたときも更新しやすくなります。

corrections.source: Keep, fold or discard? EastMallBuy packaging decisions before a return
corrections.translation: 箱を残す・たたむ・処分する：EastMallBuyで返品する前の包装の扱い方

corrections.source: Removing a retail box can make an outbound parcel smaller. It can also remove the product's protection, identification or evidence needed for a return. Decide what each layer does before sending disposal instructions.
corrections.translation: 小売箱を外すと国際配送の荷物を小さくできる場合がありますが、商品の保護、識別、返品に必要な証拠も失うかもしれません。どの包装にどんな役割があるかを考えてから処分を頼みます。

corrections.source: Identify the layer you are talking about
corrections.translation: どの包装を指すか具体的に示す

corrections.source: A request to “remove the box” sounds precise until you unpack the word box.
