A single delivery can arrive in a seller's shipping carton, a printed retail carton, a moulded insert, a fabric bag and a protective sleeve. Only some of these layers may affect the product's resale condition or the seller's acceptance of a return. Others may be expendable after intake. Give each layer a name and, if the location is unclear, use a photograph with the relevant part indicated.
corrections.translation: 「箱を外してください」だけでは、配送用段ボール、印刷入りの小売箱、成形された中敷き、布袋、保護スリーブのどれを指すか分かりません。返品時の状態や販売店の受け入れに関係するものも、入荷後は不要なものもあります。一つずつ名前を付け、位置が分かりにくい場合は写真で該当部分を示します。

corrections.source: Picture a pair of glasses arriving inside a hard case. The case sits in a printed presentation sleeve, itself wrapped in plain protective cardboard. Removing the plain outer delivery box is different from throwing away the hard case. Even removing the presentation sleeve could matter if the seller's listing includes it as part of a gift set. Before requesting a change, compare the selected option and purchase description with the layers actually shown. Record which items were sold as contents and which materials merely protected them in transit.
corrections.translation: 眼鏡のハードケースに印刷入りの化粧スリーブが付き、外側を無地の段ボールが覆った例を考えます。外の段ボールを外すこととハードケースを捨てることは違います。化粧スリーブもギフトセットに含まれるなら重要です。注文仕様・購入時の説明と写っている各層を比べ、販売された内容物と輸送用の保護材を区別します。

corrections.source: Decide whether the purchase is settled
corrections.translation: 注文の確認や返品相談が済んでいるか調べる

corrections.source: Read any outstanding questions attached to the order first. Is the quantity correct? Has anyone checked the colour or size? Are there scratches, missing pieces or a pending exchange request? When the purchase is still under review, the value of retaining packaging can extend beyond protection. The retail label may connect a disputed unit to its seller option. The packing arrangement may help explain the condition in which the item arrived. Discarding either source of information can make the later discussion harder.
corrections.translation: 数量、色、サイズの確認、傷、付属品不足、交換依頼など未解決のことを先に読みます。確認中の商品の包装は保護以外にも役立ちます。小売ラベルが商品と注文仕様を結び、元の詰め方が到着状態を説明することがあります。どちらかを捨てると、後の問い合わせに必要な情報を失いかねません。

corrections.source: EastMallBuy organizes its return policy by stage. Once a seller has received a purchase or the warehouse has received the goods, the applicable merchant terms and order circumstances matter. Ask whether the relevant seller requires packaging, labels, inserts or attached tags for the requested remedy. Keep the answer with its order reference. A comment about another seller's return approval does not establish what this seller will accept. If the answer is still pending and disposal would be irreversible, leave that layer intact while clarifying your options.
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyの返品規定は注文の段階別です。販売店に発注済み、または倉庫受領済みなら、販売店の条件や取引の状況が関係します。希望対応に元の包装、ラベル、中敷き、付けたままのタグが必要か、その販売店に確認し、回答を注文番号と一緒に保管します。他店が応じた例だけで自分の返品条件は決まりません。回答待ちなら、捨てると戻せない包装はそのまま残します。

corrections.source: Compare protection before comparing dimensions
corrections.translation: 寸法を比べる前に保護の役割を調べる

corrections.source: Examine how the current package restrains the item. Does a stiff insert support a delicate handle? Does the inner case prevent pressure on a lens? Does the retail box keep two surfaces from rubbing together? A smaller parcel that removes those functions has changed more than volume. Describe the protective job in practical terms before deciding whether another material can perform it. Two objects that fit in the same physical space can still damage one another if the parcel moves.
corrections.translation: 中敷きが繊細な持ち手を支えている、内ケースがレンズへの圧迫を防ぐ、小売箱が表面同士の擦れを防ぐなど、現在の包装が商品をどう固定しているかを見ます。箱を小さくすると容積以外の条件も変わります。残すべき機能を具体的に書き、他の材料で代替できるか確かめます。同じ空間に収まっても、輸送中に動けば互いを傷めることがあります。

corrections.source: For the glasses example, suppose the hard case is staying. The presentation sleeve adds little padding, while the plain carton prevents the hard case from moving against a metal accessory. If the outer carton is removed, you still need a way to separate that accessory. If the case itself is removed, you need to consider pressure on the frames and lenses, not just surface scratches. Ask about available repacking choices and their dimensions rather than writing an instruction that leaves the warehouse to infer which risks you accept.
corrections.translation: 眼鏡のハードケースを残す例で、化粧スリーブの緩衝効果は小さくても、無地の箱が隣の金属小物との接触を防いでいるとします。無地の箱を外すなら別の仕切りが必要です。ハードケースまで外せば、擦り傷だけでなくフレームやレンズへの圧力も問題になります。どの危険を許容できるか倉庫任せにせず、利用できる再梱包方法と外寸を尋ねます。

corrections.source: Measure the saving at the parcel level
corrections.translation: 節約分を配送する荷物全体で測る

corrections.source: EastMallBuy's freight help explains why dimensional weight can make a large parcel cost more than another parcel of equal scale weight. Measure the proposed outer parcel, not just the retail box you hope to remove. If the longest side of the international carton is set by another item, folding one small box may save almost no billable space. If one empty retail box determines the carton height, changing it may materially affect the quote. The external carton is the object the route rates.
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyの送料案内では、同じ実重量でも大きい箱は容積重量によって高くなる場合があると説明されています。外したい小売箱だけでなく国際配送する荷物の外寸を測ります。別の商品がすでに長辺を決めていれば、小箱を畳んでも課金容積はほぼ変わりません。逆に空の小売箱が高さを決めていれば削減の効果があります。運送会社が見るのは外箱です。

corrections.source: Use a fictional case to see the distinction. A presentation box occupies 28 by 20 by 10 centimetres, but a rigid item beside it already requires a parcel 30 centimetres tall. Removing the presentation box may create an internal gap without reducing the exterior at all. Conversely, a retail lid that sticks up just two centimetres above every other item might require a taller carton. Record the proposed external dimensions and packed weight for both versions. Ask for the route calculation applicable to the actual destination and contents.
corrections.translation: 架空の例で化粧箱が28×20×10センチでも、隣の硬い商品に高さ30センチの外箱が必要なら、化粧箱を外しても内部に空間ができるだけかもしれません。逆に小売箱のふたが他の物より2センチ高いだけで、一段高い外箱が必要になる場合もあります。両案の配送箱の外寸と梱包後重量を控え、実際の配送先と内容品で運賃を計算してもらいます。

corrections.source: Specify what should happen to the saved components
corrections.translation: 残す部品や包装の扱いを指定する

corrections.source: Sometimes the choice is to fold and retain the retail carton. State whether flattening is acceptable, whether the lid or sleeve should remain assembled and where the loose item should be placed. A collector or gift recipient may care about creases; another buyer may only need the printed model label. Decide which feature matters before asking for a change. If the original carton uses a glued or rigid construction, folding may not be possible without damaging it, however easy a rectangular diagram makes it look.
corrections.translation: 小売箱を畳んで残す方法もあります。折ってよいか、ふたやスリーブは組み立てたままか、取り出した部品をどこへ入れるかを書きます。収集用や贈答用なら折り目が気になり、別の人は型番ラベルだけが必要かもしれません。接着式や硬い箱は、図では簡単そうでも傷めずに畳めない場合があります。

corrections.source: Write a short instruction such as: keep the hard case and cloth; retain the labelled presentation sleeve flat only if it folds along its existing seams; remove the plain seller delivery cardboard after recording the label; keep the metal accessory separately wrapped. This is an example of the level of detail, not a service promise. Check what the warehouse can actually do. If it offers a simpler set of options, choose the available option that meets your requirements or ask one question about the specific exception.
corrections.translation: 指示の一例は「ハードケースと布は残す。印刷入りスリーブは既存の折り線だけで畳める場合に限り平らにして保管。無地の配送箱はラベルを記録してから外す。金属小物は別に包む」です。これらが利用可能という保証ではありません。実際の倉庫サービスを確認し、選択肢が限られる場合は条件に合うものを選ぶか、必要な例外を一つ具体的に相談します。

corrections.source: Document the condition before and after the change
corrections.translation: 変更前と変更後の状態を記録する

corrections.source: Keep an overview showing the item and its original layers together. Save close pictures of existing dents or tears if they may be relevant to an open case. When a seller label is important, record the model or option marking as well as a readable image. A detached photograph of a label without its connection to the unit can be ambiguous. Keep personal delivery details out of any imagery you share outside the order's private support channel.
corrections.translation: 商品と元の包装一式が分かる全体写真を残します。相談中のへこみや破れがあれば接写も保存します。販売店のラベルが重要なら、型番や仕様の文字と、それがどの商品に付いていたかの両方を記録します。ラベルだけの写真では取り違えが起きます。注文の非公開窓口以外に共有する画像には、受取人の個人情報が写らないようにします。

corrections.source: After repacking, check the result against the instruction. A sealed parcel photograph might confirm a changed exterior but reveal nothing about whether the cloth or hard case remained inside. If the presence of those items is essential, ask whether an appropriate view or packing record is available before the parcel is sealed. Do not confuse a request being accepted with the requested arrangement already being verified. The order evidence, warehouse response and final packing state represent different pieces of information.
corrections.translation: 再梱包後、指示と結果を照合します。封済みの箱の写真で外寸や外見は変わったと分かっても、布とハードケースを残したかは確認できません。残っていることが必須なら、封かん前の写真や梱包明細を用意できるか尋ねます。依頼時の証拠、倉庫が引き受けた回答、最終的な梱包状態を別々に記録します。

corrections.source: Close the decision with an actual comparison
corrections.translation: 実際の二案を比較して判断を記録する

corrections.source: Compare the two complete proposals, including packing service charges, the current route estimate, retained protection and effects on a possible return. If the smaller parcel saves little and the seller has not yet accepted the product, waiting or keeping the packaging may be the sensible decision. If the unit has been checked, the seller's requirements are understood and the package can be safely reduced, a clearly specified removal may be reasonable. The right choice depends on this item and its route.
corrections.translation: 各案の梱包サービス料、現在の送料見積もり、残る保護、返品への影響を一緒に比べます。節約が小さく販売店の判断がまだなら、待つか包装を残す方がよい場合があります。検品が済み、販売店の条件も分かり、安全に小さくできるなら、外す部分を指定して頼めます。適切な選択は商品とルートによって変わります。

corrections.source: Record the choice and why you made it. For instance, retaining the glasses case protects the product, retaining the printed sleeve preserves the option evidence, and removing only the large outer carton reduces the parcel footprint if the revised measurements confirm it. This explanation gives you something concrete to verify at dispatch and upon delivery. It also prevents an instruction written for a soft garment or disposable carton from being applied indiscriminately to a fragile item or a product still under review.
corrections.translation: 例えば「眼鏡の保護にケースを残し、仕様の証拠に化粧スリーブを残し、外寸の縮小を確認できれば大きい配送箱だけ外す」と理由も控えます。出庫時と配達時に結果を確かめられます。柔らかい服や使い捨て箱の指示を、壊れやすい物や確認中の商品にそのまま当てはめずに済みます。

corrections.source: Keep loose inserts identified when two boxes look alike. A small paper sleeve or spare component may fit either box while its printed model number belongs to only one. Photograph the layout before separation and place each item's inserts back with its matching model number when preparing the return.
corrections.translation: 似た箱が二つある場合、取り外した同梱物を区別します。小さな紙スリーブや予備部品はどちらにも入りそうでも、型番が一方だけに対応する場合があります。分ける前の配置を撮影し、返品準備ではそれぞれの型番に合う箱へ戻します。

corrections.source: EastMallBuy returns before dispatch: find the right stage of your order
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyで国際発送前に返品するには：注文段階ごとの確認事項

corrections.source: A payment, a seller shipment, warehouse receipt and an international waybill are different events. Identify which one has actually happened before asking EastMallBuy for a cancellation, an exchange or a refund.
corrections.translation: 支払い、販売店からの発送、倉庫での受領、国際送り状の発行は別々の出来事です。EastMallBuyにキャンセル、交換、返金を依頼する前に、どこまで実際に進んだかを確認します。

corrections.source: Read the order line before the parcel record
corrections.translation: 荷物の画面より先に該当する注文明細を読む

corrections.source: Suppose you have bought a jacket and a bag from different sellers. The bag arrives quickly. You notice that the jacket order lists the wrong colour and would like to change it. A dashboard may show that you have one item in storage and money already committed to another. Neither fact tells you whether the jacket seller has received the purchase. Open the jacket line itself. Read the selected option, the purchase status and the time of the most recent change. If there is a seller tracking number, keep that number with the item.
corrections.translation: 別々の販売店でジャケットとバッグを買い、バッグだけ先に届いた後、ジャケットの注文色が違うと気づいたとします。保管中の商品が一つあり、もう一点も代金支払済みという一覧表示だけでは、ジャケットの販売店に発注済みかは分かりません。ジャケットの明細を開き、選んだ仕様、買い付け状況、最終更新時刻を確認します。国内追跡番号があれば、その商品と一緒に控えます。

corrections.source: The distinction matters because EastMallBuy publishes a staged refund policy. Broadly, an instruction to stop an unplaced purchase is different from a request to unwind a purchase already made with a merchant. An outbound shipment adds a separate decision about logistics. Treat the current order status as the starting observation and the policy as the map for choosing a request. A friend who received a refund in a different situation cannot tell you which stage your own item has reached.
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyが公表する返金ポリシーは段階別です。代行業者が販売店へ発注する前に止める依頼と、成立した販売店との取引を取り消す依頼は異なります。倉庫からの配送手続きが始まっていれば、物流についても別に判断が必要です。現在のステータスを確認して該当規定を読みます。別の状況で友人が返金されたとしても、自分の商品がどの段階かは分かりません。

corrections.source: If the agent has received payment but has not purchased
corrections.translation: 代行業者に支払ったが、まだ買い付け前の場合

corrections.source: Gather the order number, selected item and quantity. Check for an update that the merchant order has actually been placed. If the intended purchase is still waiting, tell the agent which line you want stopped. If you simply ask to cancel “my order” when several lines exist, a member of support may need to ask which items you mean. Quote the relevant line and explicitly state whether the rest of the purchase should go ahead. Save the message and the time you submitted it.
corrections.translation: 注文番号、商品、数量を用意し、販売店への発注を示す更新がないか調べます。買い付け待ちなら止めたい明細を指定します。複数明細の注文で単に「私の注文をキャンセル」と伝えると、対象を聞き直す必要があります。該当明細を引用し、残りは続行してよいかを明示します。送信内容と時刻を保存してください。

corrections.source: For the jacket example, a precise request would identify one medium jacket in the wrong colour and say that the bag should continue through the normal process. If you would prefer a replacement colour, decide whether you are authorizing a substitution at an agreed price or asking for cancellation so that you can order the correct item separately. Those are different instructions. Wait for confirmation of the original line's disposition before paying a second time for the same intended purchase.
corrections.translation: 例では色を間違えたMのジャケット一着を特定し、バッグは通常どおり進めてよいと書きます。他の色が欲しい場合は、合意した価格で色の変更を承認するのか、元の明細を取り消して別注文するのかを決めます。同じ希望でも指示は異なります。二重に支払う前に、最初の明細の扱いが確定したことを確認しましょう。

corrections.source: If the seller has already received the purchase
corrections.translation: 販売店への発注が済んでいる場合

corrections.source: Look for the actual marketplace order stage. A purchase can be placed without a tracking number yet being available. It can also be on its way to the warehouse even though the warehouse inventory screen is empty. EastMallBuy refers to merchant and marketplace conditions for this part of the process. Collect the seller listing and option text that existed when you paid. An edited listing may no longer show the exact version supplied under your purchase.
corrections.translation: 販売サイト上の実際の注文段階を見ます。追跡番号がまだなくても発注済みの場合があり、倉庫の在庫画面が空でも倉庫へ輸送中かもしれません。EastMallBuyはこの段階で販売店・販売サイトの条件を確認するよう案内しています。支払時の販売ページと選択した仕様の原文を集めます。編集後のページに当時購入した仕様が残っているとは限りません。

corrections.source: Explain the reason for your request in terms that can be checked. “I chose charcoal and now prefer beige” and “I selected charcoal but the seller confirmed beige” suggest different conversations with the merchant. Include the selection or message that establishes the difference. Ask for the seller's reply and what must happen next. An agent's acknowledgment that the question was sent is a progress update. An actual seller agreement should identify the item, the requested resolution and any conditions attached to it.
corrections.translation: 「チャコールを選んだがベージュが欲しくなった」と「チャコールを選んだのに販売店の確認はベージュだった」では交渉内容が違います。選択内容やメッセージを添え、販売店の回答と次の手順を求めます。代行業者からの「問い合わせを送りました」は進捗です。販売店の合意では対象商品、何に応じるか、条件が明確になっているか確かめます。

corrections.source: If the product is already in the warehouse
corrections.translation: 商品がすでに倉庫に届いている場合

corrections.source: A warehouse entry gives you evidence that did not exist when the item was still with the seller. Link the entry to the order number and inspect the supplied photographs. Save the most informative view and an overview that identifies the unit. If the issue is a size mismatch, a photo of the attached size label may be enough to ask a focused question. If you believe a bag strap is missing, ask whether it was packed inside the bag before treating the omission from a photograph as proof.
corrections.translation: 倉庫明細と注文番号を結び付け、到着後の写真で確認します。問題の部分と商品全体が分かる画像を保存します。サイズ違いなら付いたままのタグで具体的に質問できます。バッグのストラップが写っていない場合は、欠品と判断する前にバッグの中に収納されていないか尋ねましょう。

corrections.source: Decide what you need done while the item is physically available. Request a check or return before including it in the next parcel. Keep the seller's original packaging if it may be required and ask about domestic return postage. Open the current policy and order-specific terms as soon as the issue appears. Do not use the length of the warehouse storage period as a calendar for making a return decision. Storage, merchant acceptance and an individual after-sales request each concern a different action.
corrections.translation: 現品を確認できるうちに、次の国際荷物に入れる前の検品・返品を依頼します。必要になりそうな販売店の包装を保管し、国内返送料も尋ねます。問題が分かったら現在の規定と注文固有の条件を読みます。倉庫の保管期限を返品判断の締切として使わないようにします。保管、販売店の受付、個別のアフターサービスは別の手続きです。

corrections.source: If an international waybill already exists
corrections.translation: 国際送り状がすでに発行されている場合

corrections.source: Find the waybill number as well as the purchase number. A waybill can exist before a parcel leaves. Conversely, an older screen can make a parcel look as though it is still editable after packing has progressed. Ask specifically whether dispatch can still be stopped and whether the particular item can be removed. If the request affects only the jacket, give its warehouse entry and say what should happen to the unaffected bag. Do not assume a change to the product order will automatically stop the parcel.
corrections.translation: 購入番号と送り状番号を用意します。送り状発行後もまだ出庫前の場合があり、逆に古い画面では梱包が進んでも編集可能に見える場合があります。発送を止められるか、対象商品を取り出せるかを具体的に尋ねます。ジャケットだけなら倉庫明細と、影響のないバッグをどうするかを示します。商品注文の変更だけで荷物も止まるとは限りません。

corrections.source: Work through the cost implications of the proposed change. The product amount belongs to the seller transaction. Outbound freight belongs to the international shipment. A warehouse service already performed is a third line. Even when staff can stop a parcel, the amounts associated with those lines can be treated differently. Ask for the breakdown in writing. The old estimate for a parcel containing two items may also need updating if one is removed and the packing changes.
corrections.translation: 商品代は販売店との取引、国際運賃は倉庫からの配送、実施済みの倉庫サービスはさらに別の明細です。出庫を止められても、それぞれの費用が同じ扱いとは限らないため内訳を書面で求めます。二点入りの荷物から一点を外して梱包を変えるなら、旧見積もりも更新が必要になる場合があります。

corrections.source: Track the money with the same precision as the goods
corrections.translation: 商品と同じ精度で返金を照合する

corrections.source: Make a short reconciliation record with four fields: original charge, expected refund, actual credit and destination. Record currency as well as amount. A quote given in yuan and a card statement in euros cannot be compared as bare numbers. Keep the reference for each transaction and check whether the case concerns a merchant refund, return postage or a separate withdrawal of an account balance. These may appear in different places and on different days.
corrections.translation: 「元の請求額」「返金予定額」「実際の入金」「返金先」の四つを記し、通貨も添えます。人民元での見積もりとユーロ建てのカード明細は数字だけでは照合できません。各取引番号を控え、販売店の返金、返送料、アカウント残高の別途出金のどれかを確認します。別々の日に異なる場所に反映される場合があります。

corrections.source: For an illustrative purchase of two units at 80 yuan each, returning one unit starts with an 80-yuan item value. It does not automatically establish either the final credit or a refund of half the full international parcel cost. Add any agreed postage or deduction only when the agent or merchant identifies it. If the expected credit is 72 yuan after an explained eight-yuan deduction, compare the final credit with 72 and keep the explanation beside it. These figures demonstrate the arithmetic and are unrelated to EastMallBuy's actual fees.
corrections.translation: 一点80元の商品を二点買い、一点を返す例では対象の商品代は80元です。これだけでは最終返金額も、国際送料の半額が戻ることも決まりません。販売店や代行業者が明示した送料・控除だけを加味します。理由の説明された8元の控除後に72元の返金予定なら、実際の入金を72元と照合して説明を添えます。これは計算例で、EastMallBuyの実際の手数料ではありません。

corrections.source: Close the loop before moving the remainder
corrections.translation: 残りの商品を発送する前に処理結果を確認する

corrections.source: A resolved case should answer three questions. What happened to the physical unit? What amount went where? What can the warehouse now do with the remaining products? If the seller accepted an exchange, wait for a replacement identifier or incoming unit and check its option again. If the order was cancelled, keep the confirmation with the payment record. If a combined parcel had to be reopened, review its revised contents before authorizing shipment. Archive the original evidence once you have an outcome for each item.
corrections.translation: 「現品はどうなったか」「いくら、どこへ返ったか」「残りの商品を倉庫はどう扱えるか」を確認します。交換なら新しい商品番号か入荷を待って仕様を再確認し、キャンセルなら確定通知と支払記録を保存します。同梱する箱を開け直したなら、発送を承認する前に新しい内容明細を読みます。各商品の結末が分かったところで元の証拠と一緒に保管します。

corrections.source: There is value in writing a short case summary even for a small purchase. “Wrong colour found before seller dispatch; merchant cancellation confirmed; expected credit recorded; bag remains in warehouse” contains more usable information than a folder of unexplained screenshots. Someone reading your message can identify the next action without reconstructing an entire chat history. If facts change, revise the stage and the affected references first, then consult the part of EastMallBuy's live policy that applies to that new situation.
corrections.translation: 少額の購入でも「販売店発送前に色違いに気づいた。販売店が取消を確定。返金予定額を記録。バッグは倉庫に保管中」とまとめると、説明のない画像集より次の行動が明確になります。事実が変わったら段階と対象番号を更新し、その新しい状況に対応するEastMallBuyの最新規定を確認します。

corrections.source: If the order contains a matching pair, clarify whether the seller expects the entire pair back. Sending only the visibly defective piece might leave the return incomplete. Ask the agent to record the required quantity and any included accessories before a domestic return label is used. This also gives you a count to check against the eventual settlement.
corrections.translation: 対になった商品なら、販売店が両方の返却を求めるか確認します。目に見えて問題のある片方だけを送ると返品が成立しないかもしれません。国内返送用の送り状を使う前に、必要な数量と付属品を担当者に記録してもらいます。後の精算時にも対象数量を照合できます。

corrections.source: Reviewing an EastMallBuy parcel before dispatch: contents, protection and instructions
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyの荷物を発送前に確認する：中身・緩衝材・梱包指示

corrections.source: An international waybill groups several purchases into one movement. Check which units will travel, how they will be protected and which measurements support the shipping choice while corrections may still be possible.
corrections.translation: 国際送り状一件に複数の購入品がまとまる場合があります。まだ変更できるうちに、何を送るか、どう保護するか、選んだルートの判断にどの寸法を使ったかを確認します。

corrections.source: Establish the contents before discussing the box
corrections.translation: 箱の相談より先に中身を確定する

corrections.source: Make your own packing list from the warehouse entries you intend to submit. Include order reference, unit, option, quantity and whether each item has completed the checks you need. If one piece is awaiting a size confirmation or seller reply, leave it explicitly marked as pending. A parcel record can appear complete while containing an unresolved item. Equally, a shipment of several items may accidentally leave behind a small accessory if its warehouse entry is easy to overlook.
corrections.translation: 出庫を希望する倉庫明細から、注文番号、商品、仕様、数量、必要な検品が完了したかを一覧にします。サイズ確認や販売店の回答待ちは保留と明記します。荷物の画面が完成して見えても、未解決の商品を含むことがあります。逆に明細を見落としやすい小物が、意図せず倉庫に残る場合もあります。

corrections.source: Imagine a parcel containing two folded shirts, a pair of shoes with a retail box and a small ceramic pin. The decision is not simply whether four purchase lines appear. Confirm that both shirts have the correct labels, the shoes form one matched pair and the pin is included as a physical component. If the pin came packed inside one of the shoe boxes, decide where it should be during international transport. A small item hidden inside another package can be both overlooked during inspection and vulnerable to contact damage.
corrections.translation: 折り畳んだシャツ二枚、小売箱入りの靴一足、陶器のピンを例にします。購入明細が四行あるだけでなく、シャツ二枚のタグ、靴の左右が合った一足か、ピンの現物があるかを確認します。ピンが靴箱の中に入ってきた場合、国際輸送中にどこへ置くか決めます。他の包装内に隠れた小物は検品で見落としやすく、接触でも壊れ得ます。

corrections.source: Give each protection instruction a clear purpose
corrections.translation: 保護を依頼する目的を具体的に示す

corrections.source: Describe the risk you are trying to control. For the shirts, moisture or transfer of colour may matter. For the shoes, crushing or deformation may matter. For the ceramic pin, impact or pressure on a small point may matter. Explain how the objects should be separated if one can damage another. A generic request for “extra protection” leaves the packer deciding whether the priority is stiffness, cushioning, waterproofing or minimizing empty space. Different priorities can imply different packing materials.
corrections.translation: シャツなら水濡れや色移り、靴ならつぶれや変形、陶器のピンなら衝撃や一箇所への圧力が問題になるかもしれません。互いを傷つける物はどう隔てるか伝えます。「保護を強化」だけだと、箱の硬さ、緩衝、防水、空間の削減のどれを優先するかが作業者に伝わりません。目的が違えば適した梱包材も変わります。

corrections.source: Be clear about seller packaging. Keep a retail box if the box itself matters or helps protect the item. If you would accept folding or removing a layer, state exactly which one and check any open return conditions first. A request to remove “all packaging” could remove tags, inserts or protective sleeves you intended to retain. Ask which service is available for this parcel and what it changes. A service's name alone may not explain which components it affects or whether its effect is reversible.
corrections.translation: 小売箱そのものが必要、または保護に役立つなら残します。畳むことや取り外しを許容する層は明示し、返品相談中なら条件を先に確認します。「すべて外す」では残したかったタグ、中敷き、保護袋まで失いかねません。その荷物に使えるサービス、何が変わるか、元に戻せるかを尋ねます。

corrections.source: Check the physical arrangement where evidence is available
corrections.translation: 写真や明細で実際の詰め方を確認する

corrections.source: An open-carton photograph, if available, can answer useful questions about arrangement. It may show the shoe box beneath another item, the pin wrapped separately or a gap that lets contents move. A closed-carton photograph answers different questions about the outside, visible sealing and carton condition. Decide which view supports the concern you have. A closed box with clean tape cannot establish that a specific shirt or small pin is inside, however reassuring the external appearance looks.
corrections.translation: 開いた箱の写真なら、靴箱の上に他の商品が載っている、ピンが別に包まれている、中身が動く隙間があるといった状況が分かる場合があります。閉じた箱の写真が示すのは外装、見える範囲の封、箱の状態です。確認したい点に合う写真を選びます。テープがきれいでも、シャツや小さなピンが中にあることは証明できません。

corrections.source: If an open view shows only the top layer, do not claim the lower layer is missing. Compare the warehouse entries and packing list, then ask about the specific unseen item. For the pin, useful evidence might be a picture of the wrapped pin next to its labelled pouch before the pouch enters the carton. If such a check is not available, keep that limitation in your records and decide whether the packing arrangement is adequate. Avoid asking the warehouse to unpack a sealed parcel unless the unresolved issue justifies it.
corrections.translation: 開いた箱でも上段しか写っていなければ、下段が不足とは判断できません。倉庫明細と梱包表を照合し、見えない品を指定します。ピンなら箱に入れる前に、包んだピンとラベル付き袋を並べた写真が役立ちます。確認できなければその制約を控え、現状で問題ないか判断します。未解決の重要性に見合わない封かん済み箱の開け直しは避けます。

corrections.source: Match packed dimensions with the intended route
corrections.translation: 梱包後の寸法を使って選んだルートを確認する

corrections.source: Read the external length, width, height and scale weight associated with the current packing arrangement. If you authorized a different carton or removed the shoe box, figures recorded before that change may be stale. EastMallBuy's freight help explains that dimensional weight can affect a charge. Use the current route's conditions and the measured completed parcel, not measurements of individual seller boxes or an estimate copied from a different destination. Keep units visible and record the time of the quote.
corrections.translation: 現在の梱包状態の外寸（長さ・幅・高さ）と実重量を読みます。箱の変更や靴箱の取り外しを承認した場合、以前の測定値は古くなります。EastMallBuyの送料案内では容積重量が料金に影響し得ると説明されています。販売店の個別の箱や別の配送先の例でなく、梱包済み荷物の実測と現在のルート条件を使い、単位と見積日時を記します。

corrections.source: Check eligibility separately from cost. An inexpensive route can have restrictions involving dimensions or contents that make it unsuitable for this parcel. If a particular item would require splitting the shipment, obtain comparable quotes for the split arrangement before assuming the lower route price saves money overall. Compare the actual destinations, packing options and services. A valid comparison includes both parcels if two are required and includes the packing protection you have decided to retain, even if that produces a higher total.
corrections.translation: 利用可否と料金を別々に確認します。安いルートでも寸法や品目の制限で使えない場合があります。一点を別送する必要があれば、分けた両方の荷物で見積もりを取ります。実際の配送先、梱包、サービスをそろえ、残すと決めた保護も含めた総額で比較します。表示上の安いルートが合計でも安いとは限りません。

corrections.source: Read the outbound instruction as the warehouse will see it
corrections.translation: 倉庫の作業者に伝わる形で指示を読み返す

corrections.source: Check the recipient and destination in the actual submission screen. Confirm the address, postal code and contact information privately in the service, particularly if your account contains more than one saved destination. Ensure the selected route corresponds to that destination and to the packing assumptions in your quote. Do not paste private address details into public photo-review groups when asking an unrelated question about carton protection. A cropped view or a simple description of dimensions can be sufficient for that discussion.
corrections.translation: 実際の発送申請画面で受取人、住所、郵便番号、連絡先を非公開で確認します。複数の配送先を登録している場合は特に注意し、選択ルートがその配送先と見積もり時の梱包条件に合うかを見ます。箱の保護について公開の場で尋ねる際は個人の住所を載せず、切り抜いた画像や寸法の説明を使えます。

corrections.source: Read any special instructions from the perspective of a packer handling several similar items. “Keep this box” is ambiguous if the order has two cartons. “Keep the shoe retail box for warehouse entry A; remove only the plain outer seller shipping carton for entry B” provides a usable mapping. If you revise the instructions, identify the replacement version and ask whether packing has already started. Adding a second conflicting instruction without withdrawing the first can create precisely the uncertainty you wanted the note to resolve.
corrections.translation: 似た商品を複数扱う作業者の立場で備考を読み返します。二箱あるのに「この箱を残す」だけでは特定できません。「倉庫明細Aは靴の小売箱を残す、明細Bは販売店の無地の配送箱だけ外す」と対応を示します。変更時はどれが新しい指示かを明示し、作業開始済みかを尋ねます。前の指示を撤回せず矛盾する内容を足すと、かえって判断を難しくします。

corrections.source: Understand the stage at which you are requesting a change
corrections.translation: 変更依頼がどの段階で可能か確認する

corrections.source: Creating a waybill and physically dispatching a parcel are different events. EastMallBuy's policy treats the period before international dispatch separately from the period after it. If you notice a problem, give support the waybill reference and explain the requested change immediately. Ask whether the parcel can still be stopped or amended, what service has already been performed and whether the estimate must be revised. Do not assume an uncollected or unscanned tracking number proves that packing can still be reversed.
corrections.translation: 送り状の発行と現物の発送は別です。EastMallBuyの規定も国際発送の前後を区別しています。問題に気づいたらすぐに送り状番号と変更希望を伝え、まだ止められるか、内容を変えられるか、済んだ作業と見積もり更新の要否を確認します。未集荷・未スキャンの追跡番号だけでは、梱包を元に戻せるとは限りません。

corrections.source: Suppose the ceramic pin is discovered to be missing from the intended set just after parcel submission. Your request should say whether you want the whole parcel held, the pin checked or the unaffected items dispatched without it. Ask which option remains physically possible and how it affects charges. Save the answer and the actual outcome. A product-level discussion about replacing the pin does not automatically suspend an international waybill that has already entered processing.
corrections.translation: 申請直後に、セットに入るはずの陶器のピンの不足に気づいたとします。荷物全体を止めたいのか、ピンを捜してほしいのか、他の商品だけ送りたいのかを伝えます。どこまで可能か、料金への影響、回答と実際の結果を残します。商品単位で交換を相談しても、処理中の国際送り状が自動で保留になるわけではありません。

corrections.source: Save a release record you can use on delivery
corrections.translation: 到着後に照合できる出庫記録を残す

corrections.source: Before considering the parcel ready, keep the accepted packing list, final instructions, route, dimensions, weight, amount and waybill number together. Record any item intentionally left behind. Save relevant pictures of condition and protection, separating seller or warehouse reference photos from pictures of this actual packed parcel. A later support inquiry is easier when you can point to one outbound reference and identify the individual unit inside it.
corrections.translation: 発送準備が済んだら、承認された梱包表、最終指示、ルート、外寸、重量、金額、送り状番号をまとめます。意図的に倉庫に残した品も記します。状態と保護の写真は、販売店や倉庫の参考画像と、今回の梱包済み荷物の写真を区別します。後から一つの発送番号とその中の一点を示して問い合わせられます。

corrections.source: At delivery, compare the package and contents with that record before disposing of packaging, especially if you see damage or missing pieces. Follow the current carrier and EastMallBuy reporting instructions for the situation. A good pre-dispatch review cannot guarantee safe delivery, but it makes three important facts recoverable: what you authorized to travel, which protection you asked for and what the warehouse actually documented. Those facts are useful whether the parcel arrives perfectly or needs an after-sales investigation.
corrections.translation: 到着したら梱包を捨てる前に記録と外装・中身を照合します。破損や不足があれば配送会社とEastMallBuyの現在の申告手順を確認します。発送前の確認で安全を保証することはできませんが、何を送ることに同意したか、どの保護を依頼したか、倉庫は何を実際に記録したかを確かめられます。無事に届いた場合にも、調査が必要な場合にも使える記録です。

corrections.source: A useful final message describes the receiving end as well. If the recipient needs to identify two wrapped gifts separately, ask whether removable outer labels can distinguish them without marking the retail boxes. Use short descriptions that still make sense to someone who never saw the shopping cart. A label identifying the blue ceramic mug and another identifying the cream mug will remain meaningful after the warehouse reference numbers have been covered by protective wrapping.
corrections.translation: 受取人が包まれた贈り物二点を区別したいなら、小売箱に跡を残さず外側に剥がせるラベルを貼れるか尋ねます。買い物かごを見たことのない人にも分かる短い説明を使います。「青い陶器マグ」「クリーム色のマグ」なら、倉庫番号が緩衝材に隠れた後も中身を識別できます。

corrections.source: EastMallBuy exchange requests: turn a seller's reply into a usable agreement
corrections.translation: EastMallBuyで交換を頼むとき、販売店の返答から条件を確認する方法

corrections.source: A seller saying “yes” is only useful if you know which unit will go back, what will replace it and what happens to the money. Capture those details before the warehouse acts on an exchange request.
corrections.translation: 販売店が「はい」と答えても、どの現品を戻し、何と交換し、差額をどう処理するか分からなければ手続きに進めません。倉庫に依頼する前に合意内容をそろえます。

corrections.source: Describe the change in one complete line
corrections.translation: 変更内容を一行で具体的に書く

corrections.source: Begin with the line on the paid order. Suppose you ordered a navy zip jacket in medium, the seller sent black, and you would accept navy in the same size. Your change request should identify the item reference, the option ordered, the option received and the exact replacement you would accept. If you ask for “the right one,” everyone handling the case must recover the original context before making a decision. If you say “any navy is fine,” you may accidentally accept a different model or fabric.
corrections.translation: 支払済みの注文明細を出発点にします。紺のジップジャケットMを注文して黒が届き、同じサイズの紺なら受け入れる例では、商品番号、注文仕様、到着仕様、希望する交換仕様を書きます。「正しいもの」だけでは全員が元の注文を調べ直すことになります。「紺ならどれでもよい」では違う型や生地まで承諾したと取られかねません。

corrections.source: There is another important possibility. You received the navy medium as ordered but would now prefer a large. That is a different reason for an exchange. Describe it accurately. EastMallBuy's published policy distinguishes stages of a purchase and directs the buyer to merchant or marketplace conditions for a number of return decisions. The reason and timing can matter to the discussion of costs. A precise statement helps the agent present the actual case rather than a stronger-sounding complaint you cannot support with evidence.
corrections.translation: 注文どおり紺のMが届いたものの、今はLにしたい場合は別の交換理由です。そのとおり説明します。EastMallBuyの公開規定では購入段階を区別し、多くの返品判断について販売店や販売サイトの条件に沿って確認するよう案内しています。理由と時期は費用の相談に関係し得ます。証拠のない強い主張より正確な状況の方が担当者も伝えやすくなります。

corrections.source: Identify the party who answered and the action they approved
corrections.translation: 誰が何について承認したかを特定する

corrections.source: A conversation can contain several confirmations that look alike. The agent may confirm that your message was received. The warehouse may confirm that the jacket is still available. The merchant may confirm stock of the navy medium. None of those individual statements necessarily establishes that the merchant agreed to take back the wrong unit on the terms you expect. Keep the question and the relevant reply together, including any wording that limits the answer.
corrections.translation: 代行業者が確認したのはメッセージの受領、倉庫が確認したのはジャケットの保管、販売店が確認したのは紺Mの在庫かもしれません。それぞれの回答だけでは、販売店が希望条件で誤納品を引き取る合意があったとはいえません。制限条件も含め、質問とそれに対応する回答を一緒に保存します。

corrections.source: For example, a reply saying “medium available” answers a stock question. “Return this black medium with its tags; we can exchange it for the navy medium from this listing” identifies a physical return and a proposed replacement. Even this second reply may leave the deadline and domestic postage unresolved. Use it as evidence for the portions it actually answers. If translation makes the reply ambiguous, preserve the original text and ask the agent to clarify the unresolved point before instructing anyone to send the jacket away.
corrections.translation: 「Mは在庫あり」は在庫への回答です。「黒Mをタグ付きで返品すれば、この出品の紺Mに交換できます」なら、返す物と交換先を示しています。ただし期限と国内返送料はなお未確定かもしれません。回答で分かった部分だけを合意として扱います。翻訳が曖昧なら原文を残し、ジャケットを返送する前に未解決の点を担当者に確認します。

corrections.source: Record the identity of the replacement
corrections.translation: 交換品を特定する情報を記録する

corrections.source: Write down the replacement listing identifier and variant wording. If the replacement comes from the same listing, compare all selectors rather than just the one you intend to change. A colour change might reset the size or alter the material options. If the merchant proposes another listing, open it and check model, construction, quantity, size chart and price. A similar studio image offers little protection against accepting an entirely different version of the jacket.
corrections.translation: 交換品の出品番号と仕様の原文を記します。同じページでも、変更したい項目だけでなくすべての選択欄を見直します。色の変更でサイズが初期値に戻ったり、選べる素材が変わったりする場合があります。別ページなら型、作り、数量、サイズ表、価格を確認します。似た宣材写真だけでは、別仕様のジャケットを受け入れるのを防げません。

corrections.source: Make a small acceptance record with an “existing unit” row and a “replacement unit” row. Both should state marketplace, seller, listing, colour, size and units included. Record an unknown value as a question rather than copying it across automatically. In our example the replacement must be navy, medium, single jacket, same model and same fabric. If the seller instead offers a navy large because medium sold out, the form makes the proposed substitution obvious and gives you a clear decision to make.
corrections.translation: 「現在の品」「交換品」の二行を作り、販売サイト、店、出品、色、サイズ、入数をそれぞれ記します。不明なら同じ値をコピーせず、質問として残します。例の条件は紺、M、ジャケット一着、同じ型と生地です。M品切れのため紺Lを提案された場合、変更点が明確になり、承認するか判断できます。

corrections.source: Establish what must go back and when
corrections.translation: 何をいつまでに返す必要があるか確かめる

corrections.source: Ask what the merchant expects to receive. For a jacket that might include the item, attached tags, removable belt and seller packaging. For a set it might be the complete set even if only one component is disputed. Separate the seller's retail packaging from the warehouse's international shipping carton. When the seller requests “original box,” ask which one is meant if more than one box exists. Photograph the return contents together before sealing where the available service permits.
corrections.translation: ジャケットなら本体、付いたままのタグ、取り外せるベルト、販売店の包装のどれが必要か確認します。セットでは問題が一部でも全部の返却を求められる場合があります。販売店の小売箱と倉庫の国際配送箱を区別し、「元の箱」と言われて複数あるなら特定してもらいます。利用できるサービスに応じて、封をする前に返送内容物をまとめて撮影します。

corrections.source: Next identify the effective deadline and the action that satisfies it. A requirement to open a case by a date differs from one to dispatch a return or have the merchant receive it by that date. Do not infer the requirement from a calendar reminder alone. Save the seller or platform wording, its time zone if stated and the last confirmed action. If the timeline is short, ask for an immediate answer about eligibility while the item is still in the warehouse.
corrections.translation: 期限の日に何を済ませればよいかを確認します。申請期限、返送の発送期限、販売店への必着期限は異なります。カレンダーの通知だけから推定せず、販売店やサイトの表現、記載があれば時刻帯、最後に確認済みの処理を保存します。時間が限られる場合は、商品が倉庫にあるうちに受付可否を急いで確認します。

corrections.source: Agree how postage and price differences will be handled
corrections.translation: 送料と価格差の扱いに合意する

corrections.source: Create separate entries for the old item amount, new item amount, domestic return charge and any reshipment or handling charge that is actually quoted. Ask who pays each amount and when. Do not enter an anticipated seller reimbursement as money already received. If the replacement costs more, specify whether you approve the difference and the currency. If it costs less, ask how the difference will appear. Keep the agent's answer next to the originally agreed figures.
corrections.translation: 元の商品代、交換品代、国内返送料、実際に提示された再送料や取扱料を別々に記します。誰がいつ負担するかを確認し、販売店から後日戻る予定額をすでに受け取った金額として扱いません。交換品が高ければ差額と通貨を承認するか明示し、安ければ差額がどこに反映されるか尋ねます。当初の数字と回答を並べて保存します。

corrections.source: Consider an invented example. The original item costs 120 yuan, the proposed replacement costs 128 and there is a quoted domestic return charge of nine yuan. Before any other conditions or reimbursement, approving those two additional amounts would imply 17 yuan of further cost. If the seller agrees to cover the nine yuan later, your initial outlay and eventual net cost may differ. Record both. These numbers illustrate reconciliation and do not represent EastMallBuy rates, seller policy or a guaranteed outcome.
corrections.translation: 架空の例で元の商品が120元、交換品が128元、国内返送料が9元なら、他の条件や払い戻しがない段階で差額と送料の追加負担は17元です。販売店が後から9元を負担すると約束したなら、先に立て替える額と最終的な自己負担が違うので両方を記します。これは照合の例で、EastMallBuyの料金や店舗の規定、確実な結果を示すものではありません。

corrections.source: Trace the return and the replacement separately
corrections.translation: 返送品と交換品の追跡を分ける

corrections.source: When the item moves, keep the outgoing domestic tracking record attached to the old unit. Save the warehouse release date and any receipt or merchant acknowledgment. If a replacement is dispatched, attach its tracking number to the new unit. Reusing a single generic field called “tracking” causes problems when both shipments are in progress. A delivered scan on the return can mean the seller has received the old piece, while your replacement has not yet left their shop.
corrections.translation: 元の商品には中国国内の返送追跡番号、倉庫の出庫日、販売店の受領確認を付けます。交換品が発送されたら新しい商品の欄にその追跡番号を付けます。両方が同時に動くとき「追跡」一欄だけでは混同します。返送の配達済みは旧商品が店に着いた意味で、交換品はまだ発送されていない場合もあります。

corrections.source: Plan for an interruption. What if the seller approves an exchange, receives the return and then reports that the navy medium is unavailable? Retrieve the accepted replacement description and any contingency agreed earlier. Decide whether you prefer a refund, a fresh wait for stock or another specifically identified option. Make the new choice explicit. A warehouse team that knows you agreed to one alternative should not have to guess whether you will accept a second, materially different proposal.
corrections.translation: 販売店が交換を認めて返品を受け取った後に紺Mが品切れと判明する場合も考えます。合意した交換品の仕様と、あれば在庫切れ時の取り決めを見返します。返金、再入荷待ち、明示された別仕様のどれを選ぶか改めて伝えます。一つの代替案への同意だけで、条件が大きく異なる別の案まで倉庫が推測することのないようにします。

corrections.source: Inspect the replacement before closing the case
corrections.translation: 案件を閉じる前に交換品を検品する

corrections.source: Match the replacement warehouse entry to its order or exchange reference. Compare the new photographs with your replacement row. Check the changed feature first, then make sure features that were supposed to remain the same still match. In our example that means checking the navy colour and medium label on the same unit and verifying that the jacket still uses the agreed zip and fabric. A picture inherited from the old warehouse entry cannot answer those questions about the replacement.
corrections.translation: 交換品の新しい倉庫明細と注文・交換番号を結び、新しい写真を交換品の欄と照合します。変更点を先に、続けて変わらないはずの点を確認します。例では同じ現品で紺の色とMのタグを見て、合意したファスナーと生地も確認します。旧商品の倉庫写真を流用しても、新しい商品の状態は分かりません。

corrections.source: Finish by checking the financial side as well. Mark outstanding postage, top-up or credit entries as settled only when you can identify their transaction records. Your final case note can be brief: black medium returned under the recorded domestic number; seller acknowledged receipt; navy medium arrived under a new warehouse reference; replacement checked; agreed difference posted. A note like this resolves both the movement of goods and the movement of money. It also leaves the correct unit ready to include in your later international parcel.
corrections.translation: 最後に金銭面も照合します。送料、追加支払い、返金のそれぞれを、該当取引の履歴で確認できてから精算済みにします。「黒Mを国内追跡番号で返送、店が受領。紺Mが新しい倉庫番号で到着し検品済み。合意した差額を反映」とまとめれば、商品の行方とお金の流れが分かり、次の国際発送に正しい服を選べます。

corrections.source: When two options look similar, preserve the exact seller wording for the replacement. A message agreeing to send a darker version can leave room for disagreement if the listing contains navy, charcoal and black. Ask the agent to repeat the replacement code or colour name back to you. Add that confirmation to the original purchase record so the second warehouse inspection checks the newly agreed variant, even if the first order line continues to show the original colour.
corrections.translation: よく似た仕様は販売店が使う正式な表現を記録します。紺、チャコール、黒が同じ出品にあれば「濃い色を送る」だけでは解釈が分かれます。担当者に交換する色名か仕様コードを復唱してもらい、その回答を元の注文履歴に添えます。最初の色が明細に残っていても、二回目の倉庫検品では新たに合意した仕様で照合できます。
